charter_hill_1.name: 92.9 Night FM

hooks.text: The station's newsroom tip line takes leaked data and promises to chase the story.

charter_hill_1.interior: A decommissioned electrical substation on a quake-cracked hilltop, topped with a neon-lit aerial.

charter_hill_2.name: Anjelika's
charter_hill_2.interior: Host and hostess bar whose staff are bodysculpted to look like androids; booking a host has a months-long wait.

charter_hill_3.name: Bella Mia
charter_hill_3.interior: Bouncers chipped to judge fashion turn away the badly dressed; staff model the owner's next collection.

charter_hill_4.name: Charter Hill Museum of All Art
charter_hill_4.interior: Four floors of art loaned from rich collectors' vaults; every visitor is scanned and anything usable for theft or damage is locked away at the door; Lazarus guards.

charter_hill_5.name: Checkpoint Lincoln
charter_hill_5.interior: Tunnel mouth into the Executive Zone at the end of Lincoln Blvd: two anti-tank turrets, snipers, a drive-through vehicle scanner and Biotechnica security canines (joint Militech/Lazarus crew). Beside it, a concrete cube bunker serves as Militech's command post and barracks, and is noticeably less well guarded.

charter_hill_6.name: Colonial Studios

hooks.text: BD editor Renu Upadhyayula quietly lets Tech friends in after hours to use the studio's editing rigs.
Freshly out of debt, the studio is betting big on remaking the president's father's classic film.

charter_hill_6.interior: One building of sound stages, a back lot, prop and scenery warehousing and a post-production suite.

charter_hill_7.name: The Columbarium
charter_hill_7.owner_name: built by Night Corp; kept by the Tombstone Preservers
charter_hill_7.interior: Several columbarium buildings of labelled steel niche drawers; unclaimed remains go to an unmarked columbarium on the far side. The gang patrols day and night.

hooks.text: Pharmacist Donna Mixer sells hard-to-trace poisons to corporate clients who want rivals quietly retired.

charter_hill_9.name: Eye of the Tiger
charter_hill_9.interior: Laser-tag arena for team-building and parties.

charter_hill_10.name: The Flow Megachurch
charter_hill_10.interior: Megachurch that broadcasts sermons around the clock on its own radio station and Garden Patch.

charter_hill_11.name: Hillside Country Club
charter_hill_11.interior: Pool, sauna, gym, a driving range instead of a golf course, and the restaurant The Ladder.

charter_hill_12.name: Hotel Muy Caro

hooks.text: For a fat bribe, valet Glenn Crowe hands over keys to a guest car from the underground lot and loses the footage, if it comes back quickly.
Owner Carolina Albaz hires edgerunners to sabotage projects of companies competing with her investments.

charter_hill_12.interior: Five floors: ground floor has four private conference rooms, a valuables vault and the restaurant Café Divine; sixteen doubles on floors 2-3; deluxe suites on 4-5; underground valet car park.

charter_hill_13.name: L'Ermitage
charter_hill_13.interior: Secure block of high-end two-bedroom conapts, mostly empty and staff-kept; short sublets need a 5,000eb deposit; a private AV taxi flies from the roof.

charter_hill_14.name: Many Hands
charter_hill_14.owner_name: Many Hands (City Manager Featherstonehaugh is majority shareholder)

hooks.text: Many Hands won the district's labour-import contract without bidding while the City Manager holds most of its shares.
Paid per head, recruiter Lorenzo Moyle barely checks who he brings in for a day's work in the district.
The agency buys up the contracts of skilled prisoners from the Hall of Justice at bargain rates.

charter_hill_14.interior: Plain office; incoming workers are deloused, put in identifiable jumpsuits and chipped with locator beacons before transport to job sites.

charter_hill_15.name: Seral Grove

hooks.text: Rich families illegally inter their dead here and talk to AI copies of them; Netwatch would want whoever builds the personalities.

charter_hill_15.interior: Hidden underground neon cemetery-art space reached only by those in the know; holographic SAAI personalities of the dead run on secure on-site NET Architectures.

charter_hill_16.name: Ward Security

hooks.text: Ward fills out its bodyguard roster with edgerunners who can protect a client and make them look good.

charter_hill_16.interior: Compact office building on the district's south side.

charter_hill_17.name: Your Neighborhood
charter_hill_17.interior: Rows of near-identical houses with fake lawns under a strict Home Owners' Association.

charter_hill_18.name: Your Next Big Crèche
charter_hill_18.interior: Childcare for ages 0-7 in two tiers: cheap tier uses cryostasis pods and educational BDs with an hour in an enclosed courtyard; premium tier has live tutors and combat training. Militech guards on site protect premium children first.

downtown_1.name: Acacia Way
downtown_1.interior: One walled-off street of bungalows with scheduled Whitewater patrols.

downtown_2.name: Bella Vista Market

hooks.text: Some nights it turns into a Night Market where Fixers outside the Chamber deal braindance, cyberware, weapons and rarer goods for those who know the right people.

downtown_2.interior: Former parking garage; stalls include Digg's (tiny bodega), Refrosh Wash (footbath cafe-bar), Rainbow Art Supply (paint and drugs) and Fade Forever barber.

hooks.text: Word is the owner runs an info-broker sideline; bring secrets to trade.

downtown_4.name: Clocktower Residences

hooks.text: Whispers say the Chamber bugged the appliances and hid cameras in the decor, making it a honeypot of residents' secrets.

downtown_4.interior: Flats around an old clock tower; rumoured hidden bugs and cameras.

downtown_5.name: Continental Brands Office

hooks.text: Rumour: an unused premium office is kept stocked with chilled Triti-Fizz and uncut synthcoke in case Kibble Queen Olivia Forsythe visits.
Labs on the staff floors mix up who knows what.

downtown_5.interior: Lower floors public: Oasis Megamart, ticketed tours of the Oasis Test Kitchen, Cooking with Kibble; middle floors staff-only offices, marketing rooms and labs under Continental security; top five floors executive suites.

tower.name: Continental Brands
ours: sky band 38-40 of the top five

downtown_6.name: Continental Plaza

hooks.text: Every so often a dead body is fished out of the fountain.

downtown_6.interior: Concrete plaza with anti-homeless design and a three-tier fountain.

downtown_7.name: Cortex Complex

hooks.text: Reclon does unexplained chemistry on floors eight and nine.

downtown_7.interior: 3: Allworld Insurance; 4: Screaming Eagle Law; 5-6: Bodyweight Fitness gym; 7: Jack Skorkowsky's real-estate office; 8-9: Reclon chemicals; 10-12: Bioflugh bio-polymers; 20: DizCom industrial design; vacant commercial space in between.

downtown_8.name: Delirium
downtown_8.interior: Three floors; first virtual environment free, 20eb per switch.

downtown_9.name: The Eldritch Mirage
downtown_9.interior: Velvet drapes and iron chandeliers behind an oil-soaked alley door; Vey works from the VIP lounge with her crew.

downtown_10.name: Europa Meatworks

hooks.text: No one knows where the meat comes from: rumours say a Biotechnica test lab, cloning Techs in the back, or Solos hired to acquire cuts.

downtown_10.interior: Butcher shop in a converted industrial building; rumoured cloning lab out back.

downtown_11.name: Folio

hooks.text: It's a con: the tea is drugged and hidden scanners read clients' vitals to feed the cold reading.

downtown_11.interior: Back room of a bodega with hidden vital-sign scanners.

downtown_12.name: Gilded Phoenix Arcade

hooks.text: Every eb fed to the machines is laundered to fund the Triad's counterfeit-goods operation.
Private rooms upstairs offer braindances, including XBDs.

downtown_12.interior: Ground floor: classic arcade cabinets and pinball; second floor: private braindance rooms.

downtown_14.name: Guns & Dolls

hooks.text: Violet switched protection from the Weng Fang Tong to the Eastern Tigers Triad; the Gold Dragons jumped one of her joytoys last week and more trouble is coming.
Violet refuses to play ball with the Chamber and is said to be close to cyberpsychosis (p.88).

downtown_14.interior: Gun store, strip club and brothel under one roof.

downtown_15.name: Jade Blossom Spa

hooks.text: The back rooms hold boxes of counterfeits from Rancho Coronado sweatshops awaiting shipment to stores and Fixers.
Rumour: the Triad hijacked one of Mister Kernaghan's shipments from Asia, sparking a waterfront shootout with Whitewater (p.81).

downtown_15.interior: Public front of herbal baths, massage and meditation rooms; Triad stronghold and counterfeit stockroom in the back.

downtown_16.name: Moleharty's Books & Antiques

hooks.text: A vault under the floorboards holds black-market artifacts found in no museum.

downtown_16.interior: Shop crammed with rare books; vault beneath the floor.

downtown_17.name: Munch Munch Munch
downtown_17.interior: Lounge serving meals and drinks; cube rooms at 20eb a night.

downtown_18.name: New Libertine Tower
downtown_18.interior: Whitewater Security on the bottom three floors; City Manager Ortega's offices on the top two; tenants include GHP Architectural, law firm Gueller and Stravinsky, and Rael Sanschez's private clinic on floor five.

downtown_19.name: Night City Firestation #2

hooks.text: The station's own deputised detectives rarely bring arsonists to court; they tend to end up at the bottom of the bay.

downtown_19.interior: Massive fortified fire station with its own detectives.

downtown_20.name: The Nightingale Theater

hooks.text: Rising rent and corps trying to take over the space; the Guild will fight to keep it.

downtown_20.interior: Opera house with velvet seats and crystal chandeliers.

downtown_21.name: Studio Blocks A thru D
downtown_21.interior: Blocks A and D: run-down, nearly empty, covered in graffiti; C: full of corp-friendly artists; B: fashion designers, weapon customisers and cyberware detailers, incl. BlueRaven and Lotos.

downtown_22.name: West Hill Church of God

hooks.text: The Undertow build pipe bombs and Molotovs here for attacks on construction sites and corp cars.
Rumour: Skiv lieutenant Corwen Recknagel funds the Undertow to sabotage sites not run by HF&S Construction (p.88).

downtown_22.interior: Derelict church used as clubhouse and bomb workshop.

downtown_23.name: West Hill Park

hooks.text: After dark gangers and drifters deal here, and urban legends tell of something watching from the shadows.

downtown_23.interior: Ring of dying trees around a dry fountain.

executive_zone_1.name: The Estates

hooks.text: Ex-HOA president Heather Stein is campaigning to wreck Karen Davies' reputation before the next election; a killing is expected sooner or later.
Retired gun designer Eran Malour still tinkers with new firearm designs in his mansion workshop.
Ziggurat's CEO UR runs his estate with drones instead of servants, all controlled by what may be the city's most elaborate NET Architecture.
Someone sprayed 'Save Morro Rock' across the walls of spaceport chief Franklin M'bolu's estate last year.
Michiko Sanderson's mansion is the one estate guarded by Danger Gal (Security Code 10, Hardened Heavy) instead of Lazarus.
Fixer Mister Kernaghan finds anything residents want, including heirs lost on drug binges in the combat zones.

executive_zone_1.interior: About twenty estates, from compact multilevel mansions to sprawling multi-building compounds; each has Lazarus drones, automated turrets and decontamination sprayers plus whatever private security the owner adds. Sanderson's estate (1i) is guarded by Danger Gal instead. The Petrochem and SovOil chiefs' estates share a border.

executive_zone_2.name: Executive Zone Casino/Country Club

hooks.text: Manager Dallas McKennon is rumoured to keep a very rare Goosetopia collectible on show in his office.
More deals are made in the cigar lounge than in boardrooms, and landscaping chief Vibol Jen overhears far more than he admits.

executive_zone_2.interior: Casino open 19:00-03:00 with table games only; squash and tennis courts, gym, Segotari arcade, hot tubs, indoor pool; the 18-storey Executive Zone Links tower with one golf hole per floor; restaurant Zest!, poolside bar Seacliff, cigar lounge; a private rink for the Executive Zone Unicorns roller derby squad.

executive_zone_3.name: Firebird Tearoom & Steam Baths

hooks.text: Residents bring prospective partners to the private rooms here to settle shadier deals.
The one-eyed managing cousins are suspected of Consortium ties but actually hate the Russian mob, perhaps over their missing eyes.

executive_zone_3.interior: Opulent Slavic tearoom with private dining rooms, each with a samovar; the priciest table has an antique samovar said to be the Romanovs'; saunas kept at winter temperatures with cold plunge pools.

executive_zone_4.name: Groundskeeper Shed

hooks.text: The anti-Stein faction, quietly backed by the HOA president, hires Netrunners to hack the lawn-care NET Architecture so the grass yellows and Stein loses the vote.

executive_zone_4.interior: Netrunners in comfortable chairs jack into the district's landscape NET Architecture, running Control Nodes for irrigation and fertiliser and a fleet of gardening drones.

executive_zone_5.name: Growing Shoots Daycare

hooks.text: Lazarus identity checks at pickup have stopped at least three kidnapping attempts in the past year.

executive_zone_5.interior: One caretaker per child and a tightly scheduled day; strict ID checks before any child leaves with an adult.

executive_zone_6.name: HOA Offices
executive_zone_6.owner_name: Executive Zone HOA (President Dr. Karen Davies, Exec 6)

hooks.text: The HOA's records of contractors, votes and dispute case files sit in a custom NET Architecture built by Ziggurat.

executive_zone_6.interior: Lavish offices with a board meeting room, members' chambers and a reception area usually full of shouting; records held in a Ziggurat-designed NET Architecture.

executive_zone_7.name: Lazarus Base of Operations
executive_zone_7.interior: Small walled compound with barracks, mess, a training and exercise yard, a records room with up-to-date resident dossiers, an armoury, anti-aircraft guns and offices.

executive_zone_8.name: Monorail Station
executive_zone_8.interior: Members-only high-speed monorail start point: boarding needs a CIN card and biometrics; seats ranked by status with a CEO car mid-train; Lazarus guards every station and sweeps cars for bombs, bugs and stowaways.

executive_zone_9.name: Oasis (Exec Zone)

hooks.text: Long-serving clerk Peggy Pacer fills 'special orders' for residents' teenage heirs and is said to be close to the Piranhas.
Last year a vetted employee cut off his anklet, broke into Puddleforge Games and took staff hostage over a game franchise's plot.

executive_zone_9.interior: Mostly automated luxury store with a few vetted human staff; any item delivered by drone to an estate within minutes.

executive_zone_10.name: Puddleforge Games

hooks.text: The HOA board keeps trying to ban home businesses to drive the publisher out; the bylaws keep narrowly failing.

executive_zone_10.interior: A mansion converted into family home, staff housing, offices, printing press, warehouse and distribution centre.

executive_zone_substations.name: Substations

hooks.text: Lazarus struggles to vet the changing roster of maintenance labourers and techs called out to the substations, the one gap in the district's armour.

executive_zone_substations.interior: City substations for power, water, sewer, garbage and CitiNet, guarded by Lazarus.

heywood_docks_1.name: The Cylinders
heywood_docks_1.interior: Rusting Petrochem CHOOH2 tanker trucks crudely partitioned into cubes; home to the Perdivers underwater-salvage scavvers and most of the docks' permanent residents.

heywood_docks_2.name: Decker, Tanaka & Rogers

hooks.text: DT&R is always hiring edgerunners for convoy and ship security; recruiter Reyan scouts at the Afterlife.
Manifests here come out accurate or not, depending on who pays.
DT&R's on-site execs know secret nomad routes and security, which hints that a major nomad power is secretly involved.
A DT&R ship blew up leaving the docks last month; many blame Thelas nomads warning DT&R off their business.

heywood_docks_2.interior: Logistics office for DT&R ships and trucks; the company moves about half of the docks' traffic.

heywood_docks_3.name: Dockside Billhooks Track
heywood_docks_3.interior: Level derby track ringed by girders and crash barriers inside a wall of cargo containers; penalty boxes in the centre; seating on improvised scaffolding.

heywood_docks_4.name: Greenbox Storage Units
heywood_docks_4.interior: Armoured, climate-controlled storage units, some lived in illegally; a guard station by the gate has vending machines and the only toilet; patrols are irregular and the cameras have been dead for months.

heywood_docks_5.name: HF&S Construction

hooks.text: The company's warehouses hold building materials, equipment and the odd dead body.

heywood_docks_5.interior: Main offices, a large open yard and three warehouses.

heywood_docks_6.name: LoadStar Continental Shipping

hooks.text: LoadStar crews its fleet with nomads exiled from their families, offered a job or a bullet.
Feuding SK Securities and LoadStar dockworkers regularly come to blows.

heywood_docks_6.interior: Handles loading, unloading and maintenance of the company's docked ships and parked trucks.

heywood_docks_7.name: Rail Yard

hooks.text: The Snake Nation can't refuse dock cargo but fears angering the Thelas who run the Port; so far the Thelas haven't made them pick a side.

heywood_docks_7.interior: Cargo rail tracks through the docks; dockers load Snake-run trains, and DeadWoods guard the line.

heywood_docks_8.name: Shipping Yard

hooks.text: About once a month someone tries to hijack a cargo truck in or out of the district, and sometimes it works.
Andrea Lee knows too many thefts or blasts will send the investors back to the Port of Night City.

heywood_docks_8.interior: Open lots and warehouses holding crates, pallets and containers in transit; SK's best guards patrol it.

heywood_docks_9.name: SK Securities

hooks.text: Andrea Lee wants Council votes to dredge and widen Morro Canal, which would cost three neighbouring districts land.
ERI, the Thelas, the Weng Fang Tong and the Tyger Claws would all like Andrea Lee dead.
Lynn Skiv half expects her sister-in-law to make a play for the family.
Lee wants a cheap underwater salvage crew to clear canal wrecks, likely so she can pocket part of the Arroyo Concern's funds.

heywood_docks_9.interior: Two ugly twin bunkers housing offices, records rooms, NET Architectures, meeting rooms, an armoury, break rooms and jail cells; Lynn Skiv keeps an office; Piccolo, a small bodega, is in a shed on one side.

heywood_docks_10.name: Warehouse 13
heywood_docks_10.interior: Large turnstile warehouse rented short-term, no questions asked, for raves, Night Markets, projects or op staging.

heywood_industrial_zone_1.name: Aldecaldo Depot
heywood_industrial_zone_1.interior: Plain warehouse outside; inside, a miniature Aldecaldo Camp of tents and vehicles on bare concrete, with a rep who 'speaks corporate' always on hand.

heywood_industrial_zone_2.name: Agron's Boxed Lunches

hooks.text: Owner Boris Agron is also a loan shark, and borrowers who miss payments get a visit from his Consortium friends.

heywood_industrial_zone_2.interior: Concrete bunker at the water's edge; no seating, no choice, 10eb a box.

heywood_industrial_zone_3.name: Arroyo Concern Offices

hooks.text: Walker is negotiating to bring Revere Courier Services into the district, preferring a defended corp to Fixie's teenage couriers.

heywood_industrial_zone_3.interior: Bland five-storey office block on Arroyo Street; the City Manager's small staff plus an office for each member corp (Continental Brands, GunMart, Militech, Petrochem, Raven, Rocklin, SovOil, Trauma Team, Zhirafa, Ziggurat, Yang's Wheels), mostly unattended.

heywood_industrial_zone_4.name: Continental Brands Manufacturing
heywood_industrial_zone_4.interior: Multi-building complex, one building per product line; open chutes feed open mixing vats, then moulds, ovens and packaging; white-coated QA staff on day shift.

heywood_industrial_zone_5.name: D.V. Rambling Rose

hooks.text: Start-up Lightning Logistics tried a hostile takeover of the Rose earlier this year, which halted deliveries across the city until the Couriers won.
The City Manager would rather replace the Couriers with Revere Courier Services.

heywood_industrial_zone_5.interior: Rusted ship stuck in dry dock since the nuke: containers on deck serve as apartments; the old command centre is the Couriers' logistics hub; the holds are warehouses; Fixie's team uses the crew quarters; the Industrial Zone Skidz derby squad lives aboard.

heywood_industrial_zone_6.name: GunMart Manufacturing

hooks.text: Judging by their engraved cyberware, about half the line workers belong to the Enhanced, and turnover is high, often through MAX-TAC.
When the rooftop air systems fail, workers prop doors and windows open, and the guards ignore it until a supervisor appears.

heywood_industrial_zone_6.interior: Robots machine parts onto conveyor belts and each human worker adds one part down the line; two large rooftop HVAC units that often break down.

heywood_industrial_zone_7.name: The Interchange
heywood_industrial_zone_7.interior: The zone's rail depot moving cargo from the Port and the Docks to the factories; Snake Nation crews run the trains, NCPD and DeadWoods jointly guard it, and only the ancient stationmaster understands the punch-card rail switches.

heywood_industrial_zone_8.name: Militech Manufacturing Plant
heywood_industrial_zone_8.interior: Sprawling flexible-production plant (sidearms one week, armour plating the next) with an R&D department and a live-fire test range; patrols sweep halls and checkpoints to keep everyone in authorised areas.

heywood_industrial_zone_9.name: The Old Ironworks Building
heywood_industrial_zone_9.interior: Stacked containers on the roof linked by ladders and catwalks; ex-offices split into studios and two-bedroom units; the old factory floor holds the Furnace bar-bodega and street carts.

heywood_industrial_zone_10.name: Petrochem Plastics Plant

hooks.text: Constant shipments and staff turnover mean the guards rarely know who anyone is, and they don't care unless trouble starts.

heywood_industrial_zone_10.interior: East wing turns shipped chemicals into plastic pellets; west wing moulds and extrudes them; one line makes the resin used to patch buildings; little automation.

heywood_industrial_zone_11.name: Raven Microcybernetics Factory

hooks.text: Raven keeps losing its best Techs to Rocklin, so staff with design-level access now must live on site.

heywood_industrial_zone_11.interior: Multi-storey factory with one product line per floor, mostly automated and eerily empty; luxurious corporate apartments in the building for design staff.

heywood_industrial_zone_12.name: Rocklin Augmentics Manufacturing

hooks.text: Crawling drones hunt for saboteurs, spies and disloyal staff, and anyone they flag tends to disappear.

heywood_industrial_zone_12.interior: Realgrass lawns with paths, benches and smog fans inside the outer wall; wide halls lead to locker rooms, breakfast bars and a decon suite before the factory floor; mandatory music headsets; fitness centre; constant surveillance by small crawler drones.

heywood_industrial_zone_13.name: The Rodeo
heywood_industrial_zone_13.owner_name: Industrial Zone Skidz (Fixie's Couriers' derby squad)

hooks.text: The Arroyo Concern tolerates the squat only because the Skidz captain is the City Manager's niece; if she leaves, NCPD will evict them.

heywood_industrial_zone_13.interior: Officially disused warehouse squatted as a derby practice track; bouts against other squads every few weeks.

heywood_industrial_zone_14.name: SovOil Plastics Plant

hooks.text: Constant shipments and staff turnover mean the guards rarely know who anyone is, and they don't care unless trouble starts.

heywood_industrial_zone_14.interior: North wing makes pellets, south wing moulds them; one line turns out cheap housewares for Oasis stores; little automation.

heywood_industrial_zone_15.name: Trauma Team Pharmaceutical Plant
heywood_industrial_zone_15.interior: Above ground, only a single-storey cylindrical entrance; below, three levels of former utility storage divided into a dozen clean rooms where a few Medtechs work 14-hour shifts.

heywood_industrial_zone_16.name: Yang's Wheels

hooks.text: Yang is reportedly planning a second factory just for an expanded metrocar line.

heywood_industrial_zone_16.interior: Retrofitted factory with one crew scavenging and refurbishing parts and another assembling bikes, skates, scooters and metrocars; a skate park out back where gangers are welcome if they don't draw guns.

heywood_industrial_zone_17.name: Zhirafa Office Park

hooks.text: Regional director Darya Ishkova is rumoured to have blackmailed her way up, and she is a skilled Netrunner.

heywood_industrial_zone_17.interior: Old office park with extra floors stacked on top, factory wings tacked on and outbuildings for vehicles and drones; gutted interiors refitted with cafeterias and rec spaces; guards walk with Savannah Panther drones, Savannah Eagle drones on the roofs act as cameras, and every visitor gets an escort drone that records everything and may use force.

heywood_industrial_zone_18.name: Zhirafa MicroVillage

hooks.text: Rough-looking non-employees with Consortium-style tattoos have recently moved into some units.
New resident Drago does unexplained 'special projects' for Zhirafa and looks more like a leg-breaker than a Tech.

heywood_industrial_zone_18.interior: Comfortable conapts disguised as stacked containers around a courtyard of upscale cart vendors; the Vodka Container bar on the first floor; Trinity Church, a small Russian Orthodox chapel.

heywood_industrial_zone_19.name: Ziggurat Warehouses

hooks.text: Despite recent upgrades, the warehouses that supply the CitiNet backbone are worryingly poorly guarded.

heywood_industrial_zone_19.interior: Old sheds of recycled girders and corrugated metal full of cable spools and electronics for CitiNet repairs; electrified chain-link fence; Netrunners steer a small pack of Savannah Panther drones on patrol.

hot_zone_1.name: Ashcroft Hotel

hooks.text: Maelstrom's head scavver has made it a trapped, guarded headquarters; meddling with it brings Maelstrom down on you.

hot_zone_1.interior: Two wings leaning into each other under a mostly intact roof; booby-trapped and guarded.

hot_zone_2.name: The Crater

hooks.text: Rumours of treasure persist; doombas hunt for tunnels into the sub-sub-basements.
Reckoner "prophets" chant around the clock, guarded by cancer-ridden "pure souls" with SMGs.

hot_zone_2.interior: 50 m deep rubble pit, surface picked clean; possible tunnels to buried sub-basements; Reckoner guards.

hot_zone_3.name: Crisis Center

hooks.text: Medical tech, radioactive material and drug caches make it one of the most popular and violent scavving sites.

hot_zone_3.interior: Two collapsed medical facilities fused into one burned ruin.

hot_zone_4.name: Dark Zone One

hooks.text: The tight security suggests a corp is digging under Infocomp's remains; an intact cache from the dead info broker could upset the whole corporate balance of power.

hot_zone_4.interior: Ruins of corporate offices; mysterious snipers; drone imagery jammed or distorted.

hot_zone_5.name: The Dump
hot_zone_5.interior: Wreckage heaps and choking crater dust; squatters shelter in surviving low-rises.

hot_zone_6.name: Eurasiabank Plaza

hooks.text: Bank rumours sometimes do lead to hard currency or gold; the sunken floors hold drowned vaults, server rooms and file stores, and some explorers never come back.

hot_zone_6.interior: Six sunken, partly flooded but passable floors, far more extensive than expected: vaults, server rooms, file stores.

hot_zone_7.name: Graceland Medical

hooks.text: No one knows how Father Grace pays for his meds; CityMed has no record of him or his rig.

hot_zone_7.interior: Old themed hotel under fallen tower wreckage; an armoured ex-CityMed mobile clinic in the garage.

hot_zone_8.name: The N54

hooks.text: Climbers salute "Lailah", a rad-roasted corpse with a rusted FN-RAL beside "Blackhand Was Right"; legend says anyone who touches her things is cursed.

hot_zone_8.interior: Tall ruined tower covered in climbers' tags; a small tent sheltering Lailah's corpse is left untouched.

hooks.text: Rumours: the dead kids and carers haunt it, or are in cryo below, or survived feral and hunt intruders.

hot_zone_10.name: Toggle's Temple
hot_zone_10.interior: Underground; at least one of every gun ever made; firing ranges and obstacle courses (20eb); guarded by Toggle's drones and patrons.

hot_zone_11.name: Totentanz

hooks.text: Inside is mostly peaceful, but once out of the bouncers' sight anyone you angered may knife you.
Maelstrom fights anyone trying to rehab the surrounding blocks.

hot_zone_11.interior: Dim club inside the damaged Burleson Tower, which Maelstrom occupies, runs and maintains.

kabuki_1.name: 100.0 G3 Gun-Gal Station

hooks.text: G3 sell copies of a hoard of anime music chips they found in a forgotten Old Japantown bomb shelter.

kabuki_1.interior: Radio station upstairs; The Cabbit café, a G3 hangout, on the ground floor.

kabuki_2.name: 91.9 Royal Blue
kabuki_2.interior: Music studio and radio station, with apartments in the same building where Aoyama houses orphans of the War of Succession.

hooks.text: The Tyger Claws guard Android Ace's workshop around the clock to keep him from leaving Kabuki.
Foundation chair Ryoko Fujiwara keeps pressing her husband to close Delphi X or move it out of Kabuki.

kabuki_6.name: Hiroto Miyamoto Memorial Clinic

hooks.text: Bomb threats come in constantly, probably from REO Meatwagon staff who resent the clinic's ambulances.

kabuki_6.interior: New hospital with a training programme and three ambulances; swept for explosives regularly.

kabuki_7.name: Houou

hooks.text: Tyger Phoenix is rumoured to be negotiating an alliance with the Kanzaki Family; a Kimen-Gumi raid on the second floor may be coming.
The second-floor identity shop sells bodysculpts and fake SINs.

kabuki_7.interior: Gambling (pachinko, mahjong, chō-han, blackjack) at the front, J-Pop dance floor at the back, the Mini-Tyger Room with cat drones, and an identity shop on the second floor.

kabuki_8.name: Kabuki Ceremonial Hall
kabuki_8.interior: Cylindrical, Colosseum-styled building holding a Shinto shrine (Sankai Jinja), Buddhist temple (Sankai-ji), Christian chapel (Sankai Church), hotel and restaurant (Sankai-tei), a crematorium with arc furnace and a sentō bath; Tyger Cab shuttles to Denya Jinja in New Westbrook.

kabuki_9.name: Kabuki Market
kabuki_9.interior: Open-air bazaar in the roundabout where Nakagawa Avenue meets Charter Street; Shou-an tea house is the only permanent building.

hooks.text: Neutral between the Tyger Claws, Kanzaki, Weng Fang Tong and Eastern Tigers, Matsura expects pressure to pick a side and is hiring edgerunner crews to guard its facilities.

kabuki_11.name: Murakami Suiun Imports
kabuki_11.owner_name: Yoshiki Murakami (Fixer 6); run by Hikaru Murakami (Fixer 5)
kabuki_11.interior: Imports electronics, weapons, armour, household goods and vehicles; a monthly on-site Night Market sells street-legal Japanese cars and bikes.

kabuki_12.name: Nakagawa Academy

hooks.text: NCCS reps keep an office here and lock promising students into contracts before graduation.
Laser-tag champion Yuuki is courted by Militech, Lazarus and other PMCs.

kabuki_12.interior: K-12 school with daycare, athletic facilities and rooftop batting cages; NCCS office on site.

kabuki_13.name: Nakagawa Garage Tower
kabuki_13.interior: Five storeys up and five down, fully automated with drone defences; cars are turntabled into armoured containers and shelved; AV pad and Aerocab landing pad on the roof. 20eb/hour or 100eb/day, vehicles forfeited after a week unpaid.

kabuki_14.name: Nakagawa Kabuki Theater

hooks.text: Fujiwara refuses to spend Foundation money on Shinobu the Second's backers, and disgruntled Tyger Claws leaders talk of a coup or of defecting to the Kanzaki.
The sniper Zen is said to watch the rooftops to protect Shinobu the Second.

kabuki_14.interior: Floors 1-5 a huge kabuki theatre, floor 6 a district history museum and gift shop, the next four Nakagawa Foundation offices, and a penthouse on top where Fujiwara and Shinobu the Second live.

kabuki_15.name: No-Tell Motel

hooks.text: Execs hold affairs, Fixers close quiet deals and crews stage jobs or lie low here.

kabuki_15.interior: Five-storey automated motel; rooms 10eb/hour or 100eb/day; overstayers are gassed with sedative.

hooks.text: Tyger Claws factions, G3 and local yogangs have all trashed the store, and Continental Brands keeps rebuilding it.

kabuki_18.name: Sanroo Neuro-land
kabuki_18.interior: Showroom with virtuality simulators and braindance try-outs; an invitation-only back room sells limited-edition weapons to prestige clients. Kimen-Gumi guard it around the clock and G3 defend it fiercely.

kabuki_19.name: Segotari HQ/EXCEL-1

hooks.text: Night City's Elflines Online servers are rumoured to sit in a subbasement beneath the hotel.

kabuki_19.interior: Segotari offices on the upper floors; bottom nine floors are EXCEL-1 (arcades, karaoke, net café, bath, bowling, laser tag, go-karts, food court; 20eb/hour, closed 4-8am for cleaning); Elfhold cube hotel in the basement (20eb/night).

kabuki_20.name: Tengen Towers
kabuki_20.interior: Two towers on a shared three-floor base of shops, showrooms and a cyberware clinic; from the fourth floor the east tower is Kiroshi's, the west Kendachi's.

hooks.text: The children's fierce loyalty fuels rumours that the vocational training includes braindance brainwashing.

kabuki_23.name: Tyger Works Tower

hooks.text: Tyger Eats on the seventh floor delivers drugs along with meals across Kabuki and Watson.
Suspects held by the Kimen-Gumi wait in the tower's jail for NCPD transfer.

kabuki_23.interior: Ten-storey brutalist block with bulletproof windows. Floors 1-2 Kimen-Gumi HQ (meeting rooms, offices, squad rooms, armory); 3-4 holding jail; 5 coffin bunks; 6 Tyger Cab; 7 Tyger Eats; 8 Ameku Clinic and Yagami Law Offices (Tyger Claws only); 9-10 senior gang offices; garage underneath.

kabuki_24.name: Yum Seng
kabuki_24.interior: Restaurant with soundproofed karaoke boxes; every guest gets a host or hostess, so no booth is private. Security is privately paid Danger Gal, not the Tyger Claws.

little_china_1.name: Bridgetown
little_china_1.interior: Tenements beside the water, with a bodega that sells incense.

hooks.text: The LCRA leaves the Legion's hangout alone so it can blame convenient outbreaks of violence on the gang.

little_china_3.name: The Forlorn Hope Wreckage

hooks.text: Red Chrome Legion members swagger in and steal the offerings left for the bar's dead.

little_china_3.interior: A rubble lot with an incense brazier and offerings of Smash and Kibble.

little_china_4.name: Guăngbō Tower
little_china_4.owner_name: Little China Redevelopment Association (David Ling Po, Fixer 8)

hooks.text: The LCRA's offices share floors with the Ling Po Benevolence Association, the Weng Fang Tong's front.

little_china_4.interior: Basement: Gold Dragons Security, with a firing range, gym, martial hall, garage and short-term holding cells. Bottom four floors above the lobby: Ling Po Imports. Floors 9-10: LCRA offices, the Tong's front charity and a small clinic. Floor 10: the public library. Floors 15-16: Libertine Lanes, a 30-lane wooden bowling alley with a bar, where the Dragons hang out. Top floor: Virtex's VR arcade, closed for renovation.

little_china_6.name: The Hong Kong Market

hooks.text: Saboteurs tied to Continental Brands keep hitting the market, and the Gold Dragons do little about it.
Mrs. Pham is thinking of hiring local edgerunners as guards and paying them in food.

little_china_6.interior: Stalls: the Bonesetter's clinic (bone-setting and basic dentistry); Jayaraman's fish stall; the Little Red Book, a 1930s Shanghai-style bar tent with a private lounge for queer customers who know the handshake (Maotai 20eb); and the Yuenyang Tea Shop, where Old Yau feeds the Dragons for free and Ginkgo keeps a table.

hooks.text: The LCRA blocks every property purchase by Hydrosubsidium and wants the company out of Little China, but Night Corp protects it.
Hydrosubsidium's radar surveys pinpoint sunken cargo containers that it recovers for a share.
Madeline wants out from under her family. She is secretly David Ling Po's daughter, being tested as his heir, and she is dating an Eastern Tigers Triad member.

little_china_9.name: Ling Po Imports Wreckage
little_china_9.owner_name: Ling Po Imports (Darius Ling Po, Exec 5)

hooks.text: Darius Ling Po is said to have crews quietly digging under the site for lost antiques and drug caches.
Rumours disagree about why the site was hit; one says Ling Po destroyed it for the insurance money.

little_china_9.interior: A guarded crater with hidden digging underneath.

little_china_10.name: Madam Yap's

hooks.text: Every recovery suite is bugged for audio and video, so Yap holds recordings of wealthy patients.
The Phoenix Suite is kept for the Tong's most important members.

little_china_10.interior: A former small hotel. The top floor's six suites are luxury recovery rooms, and the best one, the Phoenix Suite, is kept for Tong leaders.

little_china_12.name: The Parisian
little_china_12.interior: A damaged hotel under restoration, with a cracked façade and an interior wrecked by squatters.

little_china_13.name: Prosperity Garden Tenements

hooks.text: An unknown vigilante protects the block, and the tenants won't say what happened to the troublemakers it dealt with.

little_china_13.interior: Crowded mixed-use apartments. The lucky ones share a bathroom; the rest use a standpipe downstairs. On the ground floor: a tailor, a cruller shop and a dry-goods bodega.

little_china_14.name: Richard Night Aquarium

hooks.text: Director Chung pays freelancers to bring in specimens and is getting a tank ready for a great white shark.

little_china_14.interior: Most of the tanks are still empty.

little_china_15.name: The Seep

hooks.text: The Gold Dragons hold honour duels at night around the pit's edge.
An urban legend says anyone who falls into the pool is mutated.

little_china_15.interior: A flooded sinkhole crater with a makeshift shrine around the Mazu statue.

little_europe_1.name: 101.1 Killzone

hooks.text: Nobody knows for sure who rebuilt the station; rumour points at one-time star DJ Rockaby Rozalyn.

little_europe_1.interior: Broadcast studio in the old KJBR Studios building.

little_europe_2.name: Biotechnica Reference Forest RF-14

hooks.text: Closed to the public after a Eurotrashers-Undertow brawl burned trees; now patrolled against further damage.
The trees are a live Biotechnica gene-modification experiment.

little_europe_2.interior: Narrow forest strip by Del Coronado Bay patrolled by Biotechnica guards with a pack of cyberwolves.

little_europe_3.name: Bristol Business Park

hooks.text: The Night City Tourism Concern offices are rumoured to front for a corp, a scam or a cult; no tourists ever go there.
Software Solutions on the top floor makes unspecified software and has never released anything.

little_europe_3.interior: Ground: public Turkish bathhouse; 2: DC&H tax accountants; 3: indoor park behind bulletproof glass, rented for events; 4-5: Fax-Press; 6: Black Stone Gaming, E-Z Cyberware ripperdoc, Night City Tourism Concern; 7: Hotdesk Co-op coworking; 8: Aural Experiences studio and Software Solutions.

little_europe_4.name: Camden Court
little_europe_4.interior: Restored luxury block with heavy physical and NET security; the City Manager lives in the Penthouse, so NCPD responds fast; most flats hold a private armory.

little_europe_5.name: Chopper's

hooks.text: 80/20 sells cheap second-hand cyberware out of the back room, where the meat grinder still works; don't ask where it came from.
The Eurotrashers hang out here because Kate Mulvaney won't let them into Fiddler's Green.

little_europe_5.interior: Old butcher shop; walk-in ice boxes double as bar and booze storage; Fixer 80/20's back room with a working meat grinder.

little_europe_6.name: Continental Brands Vertical Neighborhood

hooks.text: The maze breeds ambushes; local kids like Fast Eddie sell guided, ambush-free passage for 10eb.

little_europe_6.interior: Each floor is a movie-set old-world market of a different country: winding streets, holographic vendors, scent vents; conapt doors are disguised as storefronts.

little_europe_7.name: Cube-A-Rama

hooks.text: A Netrunner collective that used to meet at Short Circuit rents most of one floor; nobody knows its aims.

little_europe_7.interior: Old brick block behind its original facade, sliced into uneven cubes; one floor mostly rented by a Netrunner collective.

little_europe_8.name: Danger Gal Housing Facility
little_europe_8.interior: Art Deco compound with arcade machines, beanbag pits, obstacle courses and snack machines; gym, pool and built-in firing range are residents-only.

little_europe_9.name: Danger Gal Offices

hooks.text: Rumour: the maids and butlers of the public maid cafe are undercover operatives gathering intel from smitten customers.

little_europe_9.interior: Art Deco tower under a clock tower; thirteen floors of pink shag, plushies and model robots; only the first floor is public (client meeting offices and an upscale maid cafe).

little_europe_11.name: Fiddler's Green

hooks.text: Edgerunners swap gossip here about new Little Europe jobs.
Kate holds packages and messages for regulars as an unofficial post office and dead drop.
Kate bans the Eurotrashers.

little_europe_11.interior: Family-style pub run by Kate, her wife Audrey and family; doubles as a drop for regulars' packages and messages.

little_europe_13.name: Holy Angels Church

hooks.text: No weapons and church sanctuary make it neutral ground where gangers meet to talk business.
6th Street guards the door for free; cynics call it a stunt to drum up security business.

little_europe_13.interior: Three-storey faux-Gothic stone church; no weapons inside; a 6th Street contingent posted outside.

little_europe_14.name: Kaito Market

hooks.text: Imported Goods 4 Cheap is rumoured to front for an organised crime group.
Madame Zorina's fortune-telling stall is really a paid message drop.

little_europe_14.interior: Stalls: Apocalypse Zone Tattoo, App Shack (knock-off software), Cheek Turn (sidearms, light armour, ammo; Artie Murdock), Fifty Farms (fresh produce), Greg's coffee truck, Imported Goods 4 Cheap, Madame Zorina, Sagar Hair Saloon (ganger-wannabe hangout), Stone Mill bakery, Taco Taco.

hooks.text: Nobody knows what Night Corp is really up to or where its bottomless money comes from.
Rumour: the free cyberware given to Hot Zone cleanup workers hides biomonitors that scrape medical data.
Rumour: the company preys on the desperate to experiment on them.

little_europe_16.name: Old Saint Christopher Center

hooks.text: Word is a casino for the hotel's most exclusive guests is hidden in the basement.

little_europe_16.interior: Grand lobby with a swanky bar and boutiques; attached convention centre; rumoured private casino in the basement.

little_europe_17.name: Paradiso Terrestre

hooks.text: The underpaid dishwasher Polly leaks gossip and the reservation schedule for more than Calvano pays.

little_europe_17.interior: Guests are fetched and returned by an armed, armoured luxury AV with an onboard mixologist; the party has the restaurant to itself.

little_europe_18.name: Red Cab Company

hooks.text: Rumour: Red Cab ships Maelstrom's goods around the city free in return for Maelstrom's security.

little_europe_18.interior: Garage for the groundcars and a small AV fleet, dispatch office and a small pistol range for cabbies; Maelstrom guards it.

little_europe_19.name: Revere Courier Services

hooks.text: Revere pays edgerunners promptly and well to protect high-priority shipments.

little_europe_19.interior: Courier depot handling routine freight in and out of the city.

little_europe_20.name: Shady Oaks Elementary

hooks.text: The school's bespoke teaching is a con: kids spend the day in braindance rigs.

little_europe_20.interior: School building with banks of custom braindance units.

little_europe_21.name: Short Circuit

hooks.text: Trusted Netrunners settle bets in The Gauntlet, a Black ICE NET Architecture arena.
3-Piece runs a tech Night Market on the top floor for hard-to-find parts.

little_europe_21.interior: Rentable workshops with techprinter and microfactory (5eb/h); two NET Architectures (the Brain Bar hangout and The Gauntlet); top-floor Night Market; refurbished drones and armed regulars defend it; carbon-scored walls.

hooks.text: Real wiseguys, who once ran this part of town, resent the chain as a mockery.

little_europe_23.name: Torrell and Chiang's
little_europe_23.interior: Bespoke tailor shop; also runs stalls at Night and Midnight Markets.

new_westbrook_1.name: Aerocab
new_westbrook_1.interior: Well-fortified building: fifteen AVs in hangars on the upper floors, management and dispatch below; 6th Street guards it under contract.

new_westbrook_3.name: Canalside Plaza
new_westbrook_3.interior: Strip mall: Sizzle Jams Talent Agency (also runs the Boomtown livecaster stable), Rick Shaw's Taxi Service, a Capitán Caliente, Hardware Value, The Mane Event salon, an Oasis, Takayuki Law and the Armory Pawn Shop.

new_westbrook_4.name: Chatelaine's

hooks.text: The Street Queens boycott Chatelaine's drag nights and call it sold out to straight tourists; their leader and owner Lulu deLuz are feuding.

new_westbrook_4.interior: Period cabaret decor: faux-brass mirror frames, scuffed mirrors, distressed fake floorboards; deLuz lets homeless queer kids sleep in the stockrooms.

new_westbrook_5.name: The Combat Zone
new_westbrook_5.owner_name: Network 54 (head set designer Mike Lewis, Tech 5)

hooks.text: Every six months fifty sedated contestants with brain-zapping implants are dropped into the set for a three-day battle royale; most winners are dead within weeks.
Extra guards patrol the tunnels under the set during filming to stop cheating.

new_westbrook_5.interior: A walled-off fake urban wasteland used as a permanent film set, watched by cameras and drones, guarded by Net54 security, drones and turrets; MAX-TAC flyovers may snipe trespassers; tunnels run beneath it.

new_westbrook_6.name: Denya Jinja

hooks.text: Tombstone Preservers and Tyger Claws at the shrine follow disrespectful visitors back into the district to punish them.

new_westbrook_6.interior: Torii gate, purification rites, offerings, fortunes, charms and cultural performances; Tyger Cab shuttles to the Ceremonial Hall in Kabuki.

new_westbrook_7.name: Dilly's

hooks.text: Corporates and minor celebrities from nearby Network 54 Plaza use the private rooms to close deals.

new_westbrook_7.interior: Love hotel: soundproofed rooms with vending walls, staff barred while occupied, linkable rooms whose shared walls sink into the floor; passes 20-100eb from the lobby vendit.

new_westbrook_8.name: Evergreen Apartments
new_westbrook_8.interior: An old warehouse split into cubes with corrugated sheeting and rickety stairs; communal toilets (holes to the sewer) and kitchens, no water or bathing.

new_westbrook_9.name: HardGrind

hooks.text: The owner secretly watches some customers' braindance sessions from his couch.

new_westbrook_9.interior: Braindance booths; the owner sits on a couch at the back with his bodyguard.

new_westbrook_10.name: Holliday Market

hooks.text: Bigger merchants lock their stock in the old restaurant's basement walk-in freezer.

new_westbrook_10.interior: Day market of tents and blankets in a burned-out restaurant's parking lot on Salinas Street; intact basement with a walk-in freezer used as a lockable vault.

new_westbrook_11.name: Lincoln Lot

hooks.text: Day labourers are trucked off to jobs, some for Many Hands in Charter Hill, with no promise of a ride home.

new_westbrook_11.interior: Empty parking lot on Lincoln Boulevard.

hooks.text: Patients who can't pay join Kenta's study of Time of the Red environmental damage and endure brutal, under-anaesthetised exams.

new_westbrook_13.name: Megabuilding H6 Construction Site

hooks.text: NCPD cleared three homeless camps for the site and 37 people died; the bad press may move the project elsewhere.

new_westbrook_13.interior: A huge fenced empty lot; no building work yet.

new_westbrook_14.name: Net54 88.2

hooks.text: Pirate broadcasters have broken in and hijacked the station at least twice in five years.

new_westbrook_14.interior: Automated broadcast tower in the Westbrook Hills fed by high-speed cable from the Plaza; on-site security force.

new_westbrook_15.name: Network 54 Plaza

hooks.text: Netwatch keeps a close eye on Network 54's VP, Marylou Ellerby, a self-aware AI freed from DMS.
Net54 techs can't stop Warhole hacking the district's screens with rebel messages.

new_westbrook_15.interior: Self-contained fortress tower: offices, studios, restaurants, clinic, spa and housing for top talent; public reception and viewing rooms for tourists; Lazarus guards plus bodyguards for talent and execs.

new_westbrook_16.name: Network 54 Westbrook Private Acres
new_westbrook_16.interior: Walled, gated conapt complex in the hills; armoured shuttle to the Plaza.

new_westbrook_17.name: Night City Firestation #1
new_westbrook_17.interior: Fleet of firefighting AVs and ground vehicles; home of the Hellstriders, a squad of Brimstone and Sheol FBCs for the worst blazes and spills.

new_westbrook_18.name: North Cargo Village

hooks.text: The Prime-Time Players recruit residents who are hooked on the pirated films projected onto the containers.

new_westbrook_18.interior: Cargo containers stacked five or six high in an old parking lot, a vertical maze of welded catwalks and stairs; Kimen-Gumi and NCPD patrol the edges.

new_westbrook_19.name: Rocklin Augmentics Campus

hooks.text: Rocklin recruits the desperate poor to 'lease' their bodies as test beds for experimental cyberware.
Cyberpsychosis incidents are common enough that a MAX-TAC squad is stationed on site.

new_westbrook_19.interior: Offices, meeting rooms, workshops, cafeteria and hospital on Grant Street, linked by skybridges and tunnels to the main R&D centre; the public Hidalgo Gallery shows Signature Cybernetics prototypes and fits implants on site.

new_westbrook_20.name: Rocklin Augmentics Innovation Hub

hooks.text: Tech and Medtech side hustles run out of the Hub; Rocklin may be watching them to harvest the data.

new_westbrook_20.interior: Corporate housing joined to the Campus by a block-long sky-tunnel with a moving walkway; small high-tech conapts, shared collaboration space and workshops on every floor; public areas monitored.

new_westbrook_21.name: Silver Pixel Cloud
new_westbrook_21.interior: A drive-in with two lots and a stage for live reenactments.

new_westbrook_22.name: ValueMart Village

hooks.text: Rent collectors make their rounds escorted by Arzin Tynon muscle.

new_westbrook_22.interior: A gutted three-storey big-box store crammed with prefab cubes and cargo rooms in a dim, smoggy maze lit by CHOOH2 generators; outside, a tent maze across the old parking lot.

new_westbrook_23.name: Virtual Variety

hooks.text: Rumour says the start-up is experimenting with a copy of Soulkiller dug out of the Old Net.

new_westbrook_23.interior: Refurbished industrial open-plan code farm overlooked by the CEO's glass office.

new_westbrook_24.name: Woody's

hooks.text: The Street Queens watch for undercover cops, poaching talent scouts and gangers such as the Red Chrome Legion; troublemakers get a drugged drink, then violence.
Maxime Raunch's feud with Chatelaine's owner shows no sign of ending.

new_westbrook_24.interior: Small, intimate club with a drag stage and bar.

new_westbrook_25.name: WorldSat Communications Offices

hooks.text: Anyone who slips past the guards, snipers and sensors can jack into Night City's long-distance communications network, so climbers keep trying the cliffs.

new_westbrook_25.interior: Mostly automated transmission facility on a cliff-ringed ridge; WorldSat security plus Militech commandos and snipers; NCPD AVs on call.

new_westbrook_soup_truck.name: The Soup Truck
new_westbrook_soup_truck.interior: A roving truck guarded by students of Little Europe Solo Dillon Murphy; funded by Holy Angels, Beth El Congregation and Oumei-ji Temple.

norcal_military_base_1.name: 157th Tactical Air Squadron Airfield
norcal_military_base_1.owner_name: Estero Bay Military COG, 157th Tactical Air Squadron
norcal_military_base_1.interior: Hangars and pads for a mixed fleet bought piecemeal: Gyrfalcon gunships, Thunderhawk fighters, PAPC helicopters, troop transports and an Overlord airship.

norcal_military_base_2.name: COG Treatment Facility (CTF)
norcal_military_base_2.interior: Base hospital with a combat-wound speciality and an outstanding burn ward; cyberware is fitted free to troops with a commander's sign-off.

norcal_military_base_3.name: Estero Bay Military COG Academy
norcal_military_base_3.interior: Five floors: elementary on 1-2, middle school on 3, high school on 4-5; reinforced as a disaster shelter and the whole building can sink underground on an elevator system (triggered once, in 2041, by a SAAI glitch).

norcal_military_base_4.name: Fire & Emergency Response Center
norcal_military_base_4.owner_name: Estero Bay Military COG, 120.8th Engineer Battalion
norcal_military_base_4.interior: Garage for response vehicles, including Night City's only AV pumper truck and ground and air ambulances.

norcal_military_base_5.name: Main Gate
norcal_military_base_5.interior: Fortified gatehouse with a small visitor lot where MPs check credentials; the only entry for outsiders. Other gates are kept shut and guarded; Militech keeps separate gates of its own (Mary E. Walker Street, Norton Drive).

norcal_military_base_7.name: Military Police Headquarters
norcal_military_base_7.owner_name: Estero Bay Military COG Military Police

hooks.text: General Giovanni has ordered the MPs to root out the Culper Ring, a secret society of troops who want NorCal back in the United States and are said to leak intel to US agents in the city.

norcal_military_base_7.interior: Brutalist concrete block: ground floor lobby and garage (converted VMW Aerojeeps, two armed Militech Gorgon vans); floors 2-3 offices, meeting rooms, armory and interrogation rooms; basement morgue and crime lab. The stockade is a separate building next door.

norcal_military_base_8.name: Militech Corporate Housing

hooks.text: Senior Militech Execs crowd the third-floor cigar lounge every night trading talk of strikes and counterstrikes.

norcal_military_base_8.interior: Spartan rooms in tough, high-grade materials; cigar lounge on the third floor; guests are searched; walled off from the base with an MP checkpoint onward.

norcal_military_base_9.name: Militech Offices

hooks.text: The modest seven-storey tower's elevators list twenty sublevels; what is down there is guesswork.

norcal_military_base_9.interior: Seven floors above ground, twenty sublevels below; said to hold conference suites, rec rooms, infirmaries, cafeterias, firing ranges, an auditorium, a war room, a Tech lab, an AV garage and security suites, with heavy security on every floor. Visitors meet in a separate building with a showroom inside the Mary E. Walker Street gate; MP checkpoint onward into the base.

norcal_military_base_10.name: Motor Pool
norcal_military_base_10.interior: Vast vehicle depot: MT-4 tanks, Behemoth APCs, captured Arasaka Combat 10s and a squad of new Militech Commando ACPA suits; mechanics also fix residents' cars for a small fee.

norcal_military_base_11.name: The Oaks
norcal_military_base_11.interior: Co-ed group barracks of 10-100 for recruits and single enlisted; UOQ blocks of cube rooms and studios for single officers; 1-2 bedroom family apartments; free-standing houses for senior officers, the General's the biggest.

norcal_military_base_12.name: Parade Ground
norcal_military_base_12.interior: Biotechnica Realgrass drill field with a non-denominational chapel at the east end, a firing range at the west end and a bandstand in the middle.

norcal_military_base_13.name: The Potentilla
norcal_military_base_13.interior: Five buildings set like petals around a courtyard memorial columbarium: HQs for Task Force 384, the 157th, the 223rd and the 120.8th, and a fifth for smaller units including military intelligence and drone operations; fortified and able to sink underground.

norcal_military_base_14.name: Post Exchange (PX)
norcal_military_base_14.interior: Big-box store selling groceries, firearms, media, clothes and electronics; Hot Dingo snack bar, Estero Bay Barber Shop and COG Credit Union at the front.

norcal_military_base_15.name: The Rec Center
norcal_military_base_15.interior: Bowling on the first floor, arcade and gym on the second, mini-golf and cinema on the third; reconfigurable Techgrass sports field outside.

norcal_military_base_16.name: Task Force 384 Docks
norcal_military_base_16.owner_name: Estero Bay Military COG, Task Force 384
norcal_military_base_16.interior: Berths for the carrier NCS John F. Kennedy (kept as a training centre with Militech instructors), the cruisers Ticonderoga and Washington, and coastal subs, minehunters and littoral combat ships.

norcal_military_base_17.name: USO Hall
norcal_military_base_17.interior: Two clubs: the larger Enlisted Club, nicknamed the Relief Valve, with drinks and dancing (MPs drop by to break up fights), and the quieter Officers' Club with better food and liquor.

north_heywood_1.name: Acorn Towers

hooks.text: Voodoo Boy dealer Monique Curse supplies the drugs for the towers' frequent loud rooftop parties.

north_heywood_1.interior: Twin-tower conapt building with a party patio and rooftop; houses about half of Dynalar's local staff.

north_heywood_2.name: AmeriCar Distribution Center
north_heywood_2.interior: A fortress of corrugated steel holding hundreds of new cars and vans; 6th Street guards it, and Aldecaldo convoys load and unload several times a month.

north_heywood_3.name: The Armory
north_heywood_3.interior: Nine-storey 1950s National Guard armory: armoured-vehicle garage, full weapon lockers, military comms suite; lower floors are barracks, canteen, rec and training rooms and storage; upper floors hold the brass's offices with war maps and trophies; a large stocked fallout shelter lies underneath as an emergency hideout.

north_heywood_4.name: Blue Air Studio Apartments
north_heywood_4.interior: Ex-motel of rent-by-night rooms converted into long-term units with kitchenettes; mostly nomads on long city contracts.

north_heywood_5.name: Byte & Switch
north_heywood_5.interior: Cramped repair shop full of half-stripped tech, under a flickering neon sign.

north_heywood_6.name: Dynalar Campus

hooks.text: Regional manager Finn Fisher is rumoured to be in quiet talks with Rocklin Augmentics about defecting.

north_heywood_6.interior: A whole block on Grant Avenue in glass and steel: regional offices, R&D labs and a small manufacturing plant, plus cafeteria, fitness centre and virtuality arcade for staff.

north_heywood_7.name: Evergreen Vista Park

hooks.text: After dark the park hosts quiet deals, and behind the maintenance shed someone sells cheap guns, XBDs and drugs.

north_heywood_7.interior: Weedy fields, a creaky playground and a half-working fountain; poorly lit corners at night.

north_heywood_8.name: The Forlorn Hope
north_heywood_8.owner_name: John "The Professor" Freeman (Fixer 8) and Marianne Freeman (Fixer 6/Tech 4)
north_heywood_8.interior: Edgerunner bar with an in-house Tech, a ripperdoc clinic and rooms for favourite regulars. (Tales of the RED: Hope Reborn sets it in Little China #3 instead.)

north_heywood_9.name: Haven Spa & Recovery

hooks.text: The back rooms give fugitives a new face and new ID papers, and for extra pay get them out of the city.

north_heywood_9.interior: Front of detox baths, neural recalibration pods and massage chairs; back rooms where Medtechs, Techs and Netrunners remake clients.

north_heywood_10.name: Haywire Circuit Gym

hooks.text: Members who pay up or trade favours may get off-the-books gigs from Haywire.

north_heywood_10.interior: Rundown former factory with rusted weights, patched sparring bots and glitchy virtuality chambers.

north_heywood_11.name: Nana Meow's Nursery
north_heywood_11.interior: Shop under LED-lit trellises selling soil and aquaponic gear and seeds, some of them rumoured to be tech-upgraded.

north_heywood_12.name: Neon Hollow Strip
north_heywood_12.interior: A few connected streets of bars, virtuality joints, smoky clubs, back-alley casinos and sex shops; Edgework Escapes runs combat and heist simulations.

north_heywood_13.name: The Night City Animal Shelter
north_heywood_13.interior: Clinic for bodysculpting and treating exotics and bioexotics; its ripperdoc treats anyone who pays.

north_heywood_14.name: North Heywood Civic Nexus

hooks.text: The City Manager's office watches who comes and goes; reportedly Delvecchio's own office is the only room without bugs.

north_heywood_14.interior: Refurbished pre-Collapse municipal building with resin-reinforced walls and solar arrays; large atrium, press auditorium, cheap cafeteria and the City Manager's office; surveillance throughout.

north_heywood_15.name: Perennial Heights/The Rupture
north_heywood_15.interior: Beige office block (accountants, property managers, small law firms, a laundromat, lobby café); its forgotten sublevels host The Rupture, a secret fight club with rules of no guns, no cops and no advertising.

north_heywood_16.name: Sleepeasy Home Solutions

hooks.text: Sleepeasy hires freelancers as muscle on its delivery runs, and its 'procurement specialist' stocks whatever was acquired that week.

north_heywood_16.interior: Clean prefab-furniture showroom in a decaying strip mall off 8th Street; plaza tenants: Kibbles, Cookies, and Smash (bar), Truvy's Salon (fashionware) and Flexo's Tires (nomad overnight parking).

north_heywood_17.name: Turbine Alley
north_heywood_17.interior: Graveyard of rusted factories and gutted turbines; by day nomads and rogue mechanics run chop shops and workshops, by night it hosts betting on drone races through the narrow corridors.

north_heywood_18.name: Woodland Park

hooks.text: Local legend says one engineered palm at the edge of the Biotechnica grove eats small rodents, and now and then a drunk.

north_heywood_18.interior: Packed neighbourhood with these sub-sites: 18a Biotechnica Palm Grove (engineered palms with biomonitors, a research site); 18b Breeze, a drug shop with a famous basement kitchen, sharing a building with Burning Bright Bodega; 18c The Palms, a container community with the Terminus food truck; 18d The Shark, five-storey apartments with a rooftop guerrilla garden and the Choom Goes Vroom garage next door; 18e Xanadu, the Muses' roller rink and nightclub where they host derby bouts; 18f Zolletta, a cube hotel with small shops and the Navad nomads' prayer room.

old_combat_zone_1.name: Alice's
old_combat_zone_1.owner_name: Alice Terris (Exec 3/Solo 5), for the Weng Fang Tong

hooks.text: Rich clients come to the OCZ to keep their particular fetishes secret.
Workers are body-sculpted to order, and whether they consent is doubtful.

old_combat_zone_2.name: Always Hot

hooks.text: Nobody knows where Mac gets the Biotechnica deer for his hunts.

old_combat_zone_2.interior: Warehouse firing range; surrounding streets are blocked off during hunts.

hooks.text: Sengo's tale of a Japanese master is a lie: Great Lakes Cutlery fired him for stealing supplies.

old_combat_zone_5.name: The Farnsworth Building

hooks.text: The Kill Krashers tried and failed to retake the building last year.
Danger Gal operatives have been seen going in, perhaps to recruit the kids.
Ms. Slee keeps urging the children to move into the Warren.

old_combat_zone_5.interior: Statuary, murals and the area's only fountain, redecorated by the kids; ERI patrols pass a few times a week.

hooks.text: Flasher sells scraps of OCZ intel as readily as his junk.
The Iron Sights hit the clinic with a punknaught; edgerunners drove them off, but the gang is unlikely to let it go.

old_combat_zone_8.name: Ionic Semiconductor Building
old_combat_zone_8.interior: Factory hall of stacked containers; steel-reinforced doors locked from midnight to 7 am against raids.

old_combat_zone_9.name: Jesse James' Kosher Deli
old_combat_zone_9.interior: A sunken main floor of tables, cleared and ringed with raised bulletproof plexi for bare-knuckle disputes; house rules burned above the bar; Brick's office in the back.

hooks.text: Locals joke the bodega is a cult front, and the narrator suspects they are right.

old_combat_zone_12.name: The Lodge

hooks.text: Nobody knows who the masked members are or what they do inside.
Some think Brick trades ERI protection for the members' backing on his Council plans.

old_combat_zone_12.interior: A modest multi-storey building; members arrive with their own security force.

hooks.text: The Faded resent it because most of its power goes to other districts; ERI answers any threat with maximum force.

old_combat_zone_14.name: The Terrace

hooks.text: After midnight, smugglers use it to land small boats.

old_combat_zone_14.interior: Banked dirt terraces by the water; an ERI patrol watches by day.

old_combat_zone_15.name: The Underground
old_combat_zone_15.interior: A cavernous maintenance depot with vast fungus and lichen gardens; produce sold through Mrs. Suzuki's Bodega in Old Japantown.

old_combat_zone_16.name: The Warren

hooks.text: Haakensen proposes razing the Warren for a megabuilding; Lasky vows to shoot any demolition crew and Faded-ERI brawls are growing.
If Brick's plans go ahead, Lasky may make a last stand with the Faded behind him.

old_combat_zone_16.interior: A maze of random stairs and twisting halls with armed resistance behind most doors; markets, schools, clinics, armories, hydroponics, small factories; outsiders kept to the outer ring, hopefuls in a tent city outside. Outer ring: 16a Angel Radio (slanted penthouse), 16b Baskin Books, 16c OCZ Schoolhouse (ERI-guarded), 16d The Pantheon (multi-faith hall with a religious BD library), 16e Smithery (artisan guns, outsiders pay ~3x), 16f Uncle Anne's (meat and Kibble stall).

old_japantown_1.name: The Basement
old_japantown_1.interior: The intact basement under a rubble-covered building, with cheap goods on display and better ones kept back.

old_japantown_2.name: The Bodukkan

hooks.text: Casselle and her lover Shimazaki, second in command here, are quietly building a Kimen-Gumi splinter loyal to her.
Captain Midorikawa knows he is losing the district and is rumoured to drink Smash by the pallet.

old_japantown_2.interior: The old stages and halls are now bunk rooms, lounges, offices, practice spaces, armouries and cages for seized property.

old_japantown_3.name: Crisis Medical Center
old_japantown_3.owner_name: Crisis Medical (sponsors Biotechnica, Rocklin Augmentics, Dynalar)

hooks.text: Rumour says anyone who comes in for treatment could end up as a test subject.
The clinic is always running sponsored drug, cyberware and psychiatric trials.

old_japantown_3.interior: Top-line equipment, sponsor adverts everywhere and secure holding for cyberpsychos.

hooks.text: The boutique's most important customer is Hornet, the Fixer who sponsors the Iron Sights.
Unknown people leave body parts in the gazebo as offerings to "The Claw", a cyberpsychotic killer who once posed his victims there.

old_japantown_7.name: The Grateful Crane
old_japantown_7.interior: Plant beds inside a ruined bank, with a row of crane-game machines.

old_japantown_8.name: Highcourt Plaza Hotel

hooks.text: Celebrities and other guests hide here from stalkers and spies, and the well-paid guards quietly remove trespassers' bodies.

old_japantown_8.interior: Art Deco throughout, with indoor pools, spas and fine dining. Guests fly in and out by Aerocab AV. Staff ride an armoured shuttle bus from the Kue Street NCART station in Little China.

tower.name: Highcourt Plaza
ours: a tower at all (the book gives no height)

old_japantown_9.name: Honest Hiro's Used Cars
old_japantown_9.interior: A lot with at least a dozen used vehicles and some parked RVs that broke edgerunners are sometimes allowed to sleep in. Cars can be rented for a gig at 50-100eb.

hooks.text: Someone robbed the bank last week, rumoured to have got away with a few thousand eb.

old_japantown_11.name: Kaifū Corner

hooks.text: Recluse is the Netrunner people go to when every other runner has failed; she is rumoured to be ex-Netwatch, an AI or a Net ghost.
The inside is said to be a maze of turrets, traps and drones built to kill any strike team.

old_japantown_11.interior: A ruined strip mall under constant armed-drone patrol, rumoured to be a death maze of turrets and traps inside. Clients jack into the lobby of her NET Architecture.

old_japantown_12.name: Kid Kamp

hooks.text: The children at Kid Kamp work in a sweatshop, and the goods they make probably fund the Red Chrome Legion.

old_japantown_12.interior: A daycare that is a sweatshop in practice.

old_japantown_13.name: Kakoi-chō
old_japantown_13.interior: A fenced neighbourhood of restored pre-war homes. Locals from outside work there as attendants, carers, drivers and cleaners.

old_japantown_14.name: Lovely Drone Heroes Café
old_japantown_14.interior: Drone servers carrying Agents projected as hologram hostesses.

hooks.text: Once a month the Suzuki family holds an invitation-only Night Market in an abandoned big-box store.

old_japantown_17.name: Neo Galaxy Cards and Comics

hooks.text: The Iron Sights deal drugs from the back room.

old_japantown_17.interior: A shop floor of card tables with a back room used for dealing.

old_japantown_18.name: Oni-Yama Jail

hooks.text: The Kimen-Gumi find excuses to extend the sentences of their most useful prisoners.

old_japantown_18.interior: A former hotel with coffin beds stacked four high on every wall. Prisoners work 16-hour shifts. Sentences of community service run from a week to a month.

old_japantown_20.name: Sanroo Complex

hooks.text: Casselle is considering paying Hornet to back the Iron Sights so they can drive the Red Chrome Legion out of the district, but Hornet will want more than bribes and turf.
Sanroo has hired the Snake Nation nomads to haul its goods around the Pacifica Confederation.

old_japantown_20.interior: Offices, a factory, a shipping yard and warehouses. Security is listed as "Various": Kimen-Gumi guards, a Danger Gal team of snipers and agents, and well-armed Snake Nation nomads in the shipping yard.

old_japantown_21.name: Segotari Factory

hooks.text: The main Night City servers for Elflines Online are said to be well protected in the basement, and players would pay a fortune for access.

old_japantown_21.interior: A plush-toy factory floor with a server basement.

old_japantown_22.name: Segotari Station Japantown

hooks.text: After the last brawl closed it for three months, Segotari warned that one more major disruption would shut the arcade for good.

old_japantown_22.interior: An arcade with tournament stations and game cabinets.

old_japantown_23.name: Tartarus
old_japantown_23.interior: The mall above ground is wrecked. The stronghold is in the tunnels underneath.

hooks.text: Shiomi expects the Tyger Claws or someone else to take over soon, so she is negotiating to put Tsukuyomi under Piranha protection.

old_japantown_25.name: Unnamed Cube Hotel
old_japantown_25.interior: Unstaffed cubes with ceiling water jets and gutters, and a payment vendit in the lobby.

old_japantown_26.name: White Side
old_japantown_26.interior: A graffiti-covered trading post selling non-irradiated water and Kibble to scavvers.

outskirts_2.name: Independent Farms
outskirts_2.owner_name: Independent families under Biotechnica's TradFarm franchise

hooks.text: The Ingalls family skims harvest and sells it to high-end city restaurants, breaking their Biotechnica contract.
Jack Boles' Poppy Farm grows Biotechnica-engineered opium poppies, guarded full-time by Biotechnica (Security Code 10: Biotechnica Security, Medium).
Continental Brands sends troops to burn competing farms; only Biotechnica's stake protects these.

outskirts_2.interior: 2a Edgewood Farm (Harris family dairy, turrets on barn and house); 2b Ingalls Farm (vegetables); 2c Poppy Farm (Jack Boles, full-time Biotechnica guards).

outskirts_3.name: Jackson Plains Regional Airport
outskirts_3.owner_name: Scannelli-Odujinrin Highrider clan; administrator Sionnach Taylor (Nomad 7)
outskirts_3.interior: Small airfield with the Calbraith Diner; Aldecaldo Peacekeepers on security.

outskirts_4.name: Laguna Bend
outskirts_4.interior: Town square; public school in two wings (east elementary/middle, west high school) now guarded by 6th Street; Flo's Diner; independent CHOOH2 station with bodega; Saint Catherine's church and community centre.

outskirts_5.name: Municipal Landfill

hooks.text: Bored crews from both firms arm up and hunt the scavvers picking through the trash.

outskirts_5.interior: Dump with both firms' refuse-truck fleets, storage and maintenance yards.

outskirts_6.name: Night City Spaceport

hooks.text: Orbital Air never built the promised mass driver; Night Corp and the Council quietly scrubbed it from the record.

outskirts_6.interior: Construction site; ~1,000 workers in float homes and cube hotels, mid-ranking staff in Orbital Air Housing Block #1.

outskirts_7.name: NorCal Marshal Station
outskirts_7.interior: Heavily fortified compound; thick razor-wire walls; turrets at each corner.

outskirts_9.name: Night Corp Solar Station
outskirts_9.interior: Solar field; at least one Lazarus squad with drone surveillance on patrol at all times.

outskirts_10.name: Northern Oil Fields
outskirts_10.owner_name: Petrochem and SovOil (each runs its own rigs)

hooks.text: Rival rig crews squabble constantly; damage is usually minor but workers sometimes turn up murdered.

outskirts_12.name: Pol-Bud Cement Factory
outskirts_12.owner_name: Pol-Bud (founded by Franz and Tonya Yanovsky)

outskirts_13.name: Pol-Bud Miasto
outskirts_13.owner_name: Pol-Bud (Regional Director Dr. Karen Davies lives in the Executive Zone)
outskirts_13.interior: Cargo-container community: homes, bar, CHOOH2 station, bodega, Polish Orthodox chapel.

outskirts_14.name: Pol-Bud Mine
outskirts_14.interior: Pits and tunnels prone to collapses, falls and machinery failures.

outskirts_15.name: Sheriff's Station
outskirts_15.interior: One big open space shared by officers and vehicles; razor-wire-topped concrete bollards and a single turret.

outskirts_17.name: Sunshine Motel
outskirts_17.interior: Locked rooms, vendit hall, front counter; a rooftop lookout most nights.

outskirts_18.name: Union Railroad Station
outskirts_18.interior: Rail yard and station; no netrunnable systems; DeadWoods supply depot and bunkhouse.

pacifica_playground_1.name: The Ascension

hooks.text: Netwatch rents the aft of Deck Three as its Night City headquarters.
The Piranhas run Pacifica Parties, an event service, from Deck Five.
Chef Ryu Sakai's blade work suggests training in more than cooking.

pacifica_playground_1.interior: Drydocked liner crewed by Thelas nomads; casino floor, Daiseikō restaurant, Enervate lounge, BD clubs, wedding chapel; Netwatch HQ aft on Deck Three; Pacifica Parties on Deck Five.

pacifica_playground_4.name: Dream Forest Development

hooks.text: The Mudang Gumi digital theft ring operates from inside; nobody knows which residents are members.

pacifica_playground_4.interior: Basement mall 'The Roots of the Forest' (shops, spas, arcades, galleries, rival sculpt clinics SykoStyles and EverSmilE); six residential floors each with a bodega, playground and lounge; 7th floor indoor park with pool and mini golf for staff rated 'exceeds expectations'.

hooks.text: Rumour: patients' brains are fed Enhanced propaganda blips while they are under the knife.

pacifica_playground_6.name: Jodes Camp
pacifica_playground_6.owner_name: Jodes Nation; run by Solomon "Old Greenjeans" LaPlante (Nomad 10)
pacifica_playground_6.interior: Container blocks and trailer park; Doc Miles' tent clinic; Nomad's Market in five containers (Ojo in container three, Diego Motors vehicles and upgrades); The Ring sumo and wrestling school; Militech and NCPD stop at its border.

hooks.text: A Piranha shoal keeps the yacht owners supplied; some prefer the Voodoo Boys' XBDs instead.

pacifica_playground_9.name: Pacifica Arcology Ruins

hooks.text: Scavver crews who try to break in never return; since part of it collapsed, toxic fleshy blobs wash ashore in Pacifica.

pacifica_playground_9.interior: Self-sufficient refuge built for Hong Kong investors, sealed with residents inside; southwest corner fell into the ocean a few months ago.

pacifica_playground_11.name: Pleasant Valley Apartments
pacifica_playground_11.interior: No NET Architecture; analog locks, manual lights, climate and water; push-button elevator.

hooks.text: Hydrosubsidium blamed the fatal first run on sabotage, covered it up and paid the family off.

pacifica_playground_14.name: ShellShock Central
pacifica_playground_14.interior: Glass-roofed arena with an underground gym.

hooks.text: Playland's owners would be glad if someone firebombed the shop.
Dizzy sells the best items he 'liberated' from the park at a yearly Night Market in Volkodav's Party Room.

pacifica_playground_18.name: Tanson Group Headquarters

hooks.text: Tanson is said to be eyeing the gap left by IEC's destruction.
Unauthorised visitors are captured and interrogated; some disappear.

pacifica_playground_18.interior: Five concrete domes: administration, two manufacturing, R&D, warehousing; Council advisory seat makes it self-policed; no-fly zone with AA guns on every dome roof.

pacifica_playground_20.name: Volkodav Racetrack

hooks.text: The Voodoo Boys cook and store drugs in the basement and hold joytoys and XBD 'stars' from Rancho Coronado there.

pacifica_playground_20.interior: Dog track with betting; the Party Room (mattress-strewn XBD rental space); basement drug lab, storage and captives.

pacifica_playground_21.name: WNS Offices
pacifica_playground_21.owner_name: World News Service (run as a DMS franchise)

hooks.text: DMS talent scouts at WNS 100.2 sign new acts to predatory contracts.

pacifica_playground_21.interior: Newsroom and broadcast studio; adjoining building holds WNS 100.2 radio and the DMS scouts.

playland_1.name: Eco-Coaster
playland_1.interior: Its vibration slowly unscrews the fasteners; the Gearheads re-tighten them daily and sleep in the maintenance shed beneath.

playland_3.name: Bumper Pandamonium
playland_3.interior: Arena with a maintenance corridor beneath, where the GoFasters live.

playland_6.name: Hammered Industries Beer Garden
playland_6.owner_name: Tower of Dark; sponsor Hammered Industries

playland_8.name: Laser Light Arena
playland_8.owner_name: Tower of Dark; sponsors Laser Light and Militech
