playland_11.name: Memorial Zen Garden
playland_11.interior: The Ecowarriors tend it and live in a cave behind the waterfall.

playland_13.name: Mermaid Fountain
playland_13.owner_name: Tower of Dark; show by Biotechnica

hooks.text: The fake trees blind the drones; Bozos used that two years ago to kill 30+ workers, and Tower of Dark paid Net54 and WNS to bury the story.

playland_16.name: Manor of Terror
playland_16.interior: The Taggers sleep in the staff tunnels beneath the Manor.

playland_17.name: GunMart Museum of Movie Weapons
playland_17.owner_name: Tower of Dark; exhibit by GunMart
playland_17.interior: Exhibit halls with Nedd's custom build shop in the back.

playland_18.name: Haunted Woods Warfare
playland_18.interior: The Children of the Night live in its big storage shed, 'The Dark Crypt'.

playland_20.name: Frighthunter Society Lodge
playland_20.interior: The Guardians live in the attic and sometimes help staff it.

playland_22.name: Wharf Hotel
playland_22.interior: The Beaverdam yogang lives in the attic.

playland_24.name: Artificial Beach
playland_24.interior: The Thrashers live in abandoned-looking cabanas at the back.

playland_25.name: Grand Trolley Yard
playland_25.interior: The central nexus of the park's staff tunnels lies beneath; the Throwdown run a 3am drone fight club here and sleep in the janitor's closets.

playland_32.name: Lost & Found
playland_32.interior: The Packrats live in the basement and keep what they like.

hooks.text: Piranha initiations rumouredly end with the recruit thrown into a tank of real piranhas.
Often 'closed for maintenance': it is rented to PMCs for ocean-assault training.

playland_38.name: The Playtower

hooks.text: The Piranhas' private VIPiranna club sits at the tower's centre, where Corpse Reviver stages shows of power for important clients.

playland_38.interior: Four spinning clubs around a central VIPiranna private club.

playland_41.name: Hall of Nightmares
playland_41.interior: The Glitters live in a basement storeroom beneath it.

hooks.text: The Piranhas run a drug lab inside the closed ride.
Techs were overheard calling it a 'live testing operation'.
Militech guards the zone so Segotari's robotics and virtuality tech can't leak to competitors.

playland_45.name: The Hula Room
playland_45.owner_name: Tower of Dark; sponsor Rocklin Augmentics

playland_51.name: The Elflines Online Experience

hooks.text: It can't be making money; players reportedly stay logged in for months. Something is wrong here.
Rumour places the Night City Elflines Online servers under the Discovery Zone.

playland_51.interior: Ground floor of immersion stations with IV drips; Segotari Station arcade upstairs.

port_of_night_city_1.name: The Amber Room

hooks.text: The amber panels are rumoured to hide secret doors for Consortium members to slip out of a firefight.
To meet Valya, slip a note to the bartender; talking mob business at her bar gets you thrown out.
Valya fled a father she stole from; her people may be more loyal to her than to the Bratva.

port_of_night_city_1.interior: Wall panels of near-handgun-proof faux amber, said to conceal escape doors; bouncers.

port_of_night_city_2.name: Dock 13

hooks.text: Maze's crews haul off crates of junk nobody wants and he spins them into hot sellers.

port_of_night_city_2.interior: A dockside storefront with blaring speakers that hosts a Night Market now and then.

port_of_night_city_4.name: Dock Cargo Community
port_of_night_city_4.interior: The bottom container rows are empty and underwater; homes are stacked above, with a new row added every few years.

port_of_night_city_5.name: Flotsam
port_of_night_city_5.interior: A shifting village between three anchor ships: the OGV Lund (war-adrift container ship, under 2,000 of 5,000 containers salvaged), the Rose (submarine hub of Thelas comms, with the tug pilots' lounge) and the Sakata Maru (ex-Arasaka munitions ship, Port admin and Calypso's office, anti-aircraft guns); the Randy Dandy ferry-bar and a Greek Orthodox chapel.

port_of_night_city_6.name: Harbor Patrol HQ
port_of_night_city_6.interior: Square three-storey block between thick concrete barriers: ground floor maintenance and armory; upper floors on-call bunks, briefing rooms, sickbay, mess; basement firing range, brig, medical station. Six patrol boats (three out at a time) and a garage of armoured groundcars.

port_of_night_city_7.name: Main Port

hooks.text: Corps like DT&R keep testing the Thelas' grip; the dry dock's first job was a DT&R ship from last year's clash over unpaid fees.

port_of_night_city_7.interior: Quay 1 (6 m, hand-offloaded, two ships); Quays 2-3 (9-12 m, two container cranes each, rail to the Yard, two ships each); Quay 4 (over 15 m, one ship, cranes plus a cargo-drone hangar and control); Quay 5 half built, for dangerous cargo; a dry dock.

hooks.text: Della Glass has high-seas work for edgerunners who get on her good side.

port_of_night_city_9.name: Medical Technologies

hooks.text: Rumour says Maelstrom is a major supplier of its implants, though the gang never shops there.
It holds the city's largest stock of cryosystem pods outside Trauma Team and City Medical.

port_of_night_city_9.interior: Limb vats, onsite ripperdocs and a large cryopod bank.

hooks.text: It reportedly "loses" payment records to squeeze borrowers whose skills the Consortium wants for a heist.

port_of_night_city_11.name: Naiad's Embrace

hooks.text: The drinks are watered and the tables rigged.

port_of_night_city_11.interior: Club and gaming floor below, rented rooms upstairs.

port_of_night_city_12.name: Reclaimed Studios
port_of_night_city_12.interior: A tall block of identical furnished studios.

port_of_night_city_13.name: The Reclamation Plant

hooks.text: Treated solids are sold, mostly to Biotechnica; city Department of Water repair trucks go out under Marine guard.

port_of_night_city_13.interior: Treatment tanks where local workers filter and dose wastewater under Thelas Techs; also houses the city Department of Water.

port_of_night_city_14.name: Rusty's Dive Shack
port_of_night_city_14.interior: A salvaged sub bridge welded to containers; Sweetheart's tattoo parlour in a side container.

port_of_night_city_15.name: The Yard
port_of_night_city_15.owner_name: the Thelas nomads, with Snake Nation

hooks.text: The DeadWoods keep a bunkhouse here, and gossip says Calypso is sweet on Gunslinger.

port_of_night_city_15.interior: Rails and trains, warehouses, maintenance stations, open container stacks; netrunner-run gantry cranes, Linear Frames and forklifts; a DeadWoods bunkhouse and station.

rancho_coronado_1.name: 106.9 Sangre y arena
rancho_coronado_1.interior: Concrete bunker; short-range transmitter covering the district.

rancho_coronado_2.name: Albino Alligator Car Wash

hooks.text: The city can't cut their water without also cutting off Tanson Group HQ in Pacifica.

rancho_coronado_2.interior: Old car wash over tapped water mains (utility code 2 applies to water only); wet t-shirt parties under the wash spray with a foosball tournament.

rancho_coronado_3.name: Bread and Roses
rancho_coronado_3.interior: Holes dug up for weed beds; storage sheds converted to smokehouses; chemicals cooked in an old SCOPdog cart.

rancho_coronado_5.name: The Culms

hooks.text: Anyone who goes inside is press-ganged; slow workers are staked over cut stalks and left for the bamboo to grow through.
Workers whisper of a long-legged 'hantu galah' that kills by snapping its legs together — likely a cyberpsycho with extending legs.

rancho_coronado_5.interior: Overgrown garden-centre lot full of hissing, creaking bamboo; harvest crews work 24/7.

rancho_coronado_6.name: Digital Divinity Ruins

hooks.text: Locals say the hole is cursed: whoever crawls in never comes out.

rancho_coronado_6.interior: Demolished compound; a hole in the ground leading underneath.

rancho_coronado_7.name: Eagle Rock Stadium
rancho_coronado_7.interior: Container community at an old stadium; Destiny Street nearby changes gang hands weekly.

rancho_coronado_8.name: The Henhouse
rancho_coronado_8.owner_name: Big Bruno (Solo 3); team managed by Vernie Shirley (Solo 2)
rancho_coronado_8.interior: Big leaky-roofed store floor converted into a derby track.

rancho_coronado_9.name: The Island

hooks.text: The gang doles out food and water to the tent dwellers to keep them in debt slavery: a source of labour, mules, recruits and XBD 'stars'.
Tonton Macoute grooms streetrats with drugs and ships them to Pacifica for XBDs and tourist rentals.

rancho_coronado_9.interior: Fortified multiplex holding drug storehouses and the armoury; only ranked members live inside; prospects sleep in the tent ring.

rancho_coronado_10.name: Jack 'N' the Green
rancho_coronado_10.interior: Fenced subdivision of rotting houses and yards turned into gardens; thieves go into the composter.

rancho_coronado_maquiladoras.name: The Maquiladoras
rancho_coronado_maquiladoras.owner_name: Various: clothing labels, 6th Street, El Norte Cartel, Weng Fang Tong

hooks.text: 6th Street runs one turning out ammunition and armour.
El Norte Cartel workers assemble guns from parts smuggled up from SoCal.
The Weng Fang Tong just stole a knock-off goods shop from the Eastern Tigers Triad, who will likely take it back.

rancho_coronado_maquiladoras.interior: Workshop floors; overseers rent dorm beds, everyone else sleeps on cardboard in storerooms.

rancho_coronado_11.name: Minimallism
rancho_coronado_11.owner_name: Fixer consortium; guarded by 6th Street's Pickens Squad (One-K, Lawman 4)

hooks.text: 6th Street's founder X sent One-K to map the district's power structure ahead of a bid for the City Manager seat.
Sara Snow's discount patients agree to test her experimental panacea serums.

rancho_coronado_11.interior: 6th Street Station in an old electronics store; half a dozen fixers' RC Night Markets weekly; Ms. Mynah's office off the central plaza; The Samaritan clinic in a former sculpt shop; XOOX bodega in the old food court (Steel Vaqueros kin).

reclamation_zone_1.name: Booster Bistro
reclamation_zone_1.interior: Flimsy building with second-hand everything; a chicken coop out back.

reclamation_zone_2.name: Country Cars
reclamation_zone_2.interior: Old train cars divided into container-sized bunks round a lively courtyard.

reclamation_zone_3.name: Earl's Second Hand Shop

hooks.text: Earl is said to run a healthy trade in porn BDs out the back.

reclamation_zone_3.interior: Floor-to-ceiling second-hand goods, from third-hand firearms to toys.

reclamation_zone_4.name: Flashback

hooks.text: Visiting suits get drunk on full cans of Smash and are easy to charm information out of.

reclamation_zone_4.interior: White tile, bright geometric colour, old movie posters and props.

hooks.text: Graduates from outside the district keep vanishing; sources say Torin sells their contracts to shady buyers.

reclamation_zone_6.name: Freddie Douglas School
reclamation_zone_6.interior: An underground bomb shelter built to survive a nuclear strike.

reclamation_zone_7.name: Gordon's Garage
reclamation_zone_7.interior: Vehicle armouring garage with a half-finished punknaught in the back yard; apartments above.

reclamation_zone_8.name: McGee Speedway
reclamation_zone_8.interior: Dirt track with picnic and play grounds; Santos presides over special events.

reclamation_zone_9.name: Herschel's Crematorium
reclamation_zone_9.interior: Crematorium with spare coffins for overnight guests; a few Tombstone Preservers usually on site.

reclamation_zone_10.name: La Perrera

hooks.text: Titan will pay for information on the rising Kill Krasher raids.

reclamation_zone_10.interior: Brick-walled compound: militia HQ, jail cells, kennels and dog training.

reclamation_zone_12.name: Mobile Mosque Prayer Center

hooks.text: The Imam is in talks with Muslims working at the Spaceport to raise funds for a permanent mosque.

reclamation_zone_12.interior: Expanding truck hall with white-noise walls, outdoor washing stations and call-to-prayer speakers.

reclamation_zone_13.name: NCART Yards

hooks.text: The district suffers occasional sabotage that locals suspect Haakensen of sponsoring.

reclamation_zone_13.interior: Engines, a dozen train cars and buses on the lot; repair vehicles, railcars and pump trucks for flooded tunnels; kombi mobile offices for Santos and managers; a bunk container for drivers; Solo guards.

reclamation_zone_14.name: Reclamation Zone Station

hooks.text: Eggheadz owner Webspinner is rumoured to be a Mudang Gumi agent.

reclamation_zone_14.interior: Beaux-Arts station; the Underground Market below the platform: Carmen's Cosmetics, Eggheadz (cyberdecks and programs), Forever Beautiful (plastic flowers), Forgotten Treasures (scrap jewellery), Underground Bodega (Mrs. Suzuki's chain).

hooks.text: Phoebe quietly handles jobs for most of the district's power players, the City Manager included.

santo_domingo_2.name: Aldecaldo Camp
santo_domingo_2.owner_name: Aldecaldos; camp run by Izzy Lobo (Nomad 10)
santo_domingo_2.interior: Shifting camp; sub-sites: AllNations Construction (three containers on a MegaHauler, issues temp IDs and plates), Bazaar El Saber day market (Doc Spindler's ripper stall), Caitlin Market (groceries and guns, Peacekeeper Golem patrols), Doc P's school (K-12), Radio Tent comms hub, Skinny James' Lot (hire nomad crews), Sol Canela Park, Tepui overnight kombi lot.

santo_domingo_3.name: Aldecaldo Peacekeepers HQ
santo_domingo_3.interior: Reclaimed complex: many vehicle garages, dormitories, a small holding jail.

santo_domingo_5.name: Altar a Nuestra Señora de la Santa Muerte
santo_domingo_5.interior: Abandoned Militech warehouse housing the altar; steady foot traffic in and out.

santo_domingo_6.name: Ciudad Techito
santo_domingo_6.interior: Unmappable shifting sprawl; local kids guide visitors for 5-10eb.

santo_domingo_7.name: Coronado Dam

hooks.text: Kill Krasher crews sometimes try to RPG the dam to flood Santo Domingo; the nomads fight them off.

santo_domingo_7.interior: Dam with Petrochem Security teams on site; the Aldecaldo Camp sits at its base.

santo_domingo_9.name: Heywood Suites
santo_domingo_9.interior: Noise and vibration dampers, soundproofed units, furniture bolted down; road trains rumble overhead.

santo_domingo_10.name: Hunger Street
santo_domingo_10.interior: Trucks include Buck-a-Slice, Cart Chrome (brain solution for FBC builders), Monster T, SharkBites, TacoSCOP.

santo_domingo_12.name: María's
santo_domingo_12.interior: Open-air tent with lawn furniture chained down.

santo_domingo_13.name: Megabuilding H4

hooks.text: El Norte is said to run an identity-swap operation behind the H4 Clinic.
Netwatch is probing Heywood Community Bank as a front for a cartel phone/CitiNet scam.
The Bar of Gold BD den is a Rat Kings hangout.

santo_domingo_13.interior: Lower levels occupied; tenants: Bar of Gold (BD den/club), Pink Mohawk (fashionware salon), Gatcha Hotel (100 capsules, 50eb/night), H4 Clinic (ripperdoc), Heywood Community Bank, YoBro! (gun shop and range).

santo_domingo_14.name: MetalStorm
santo_domingo_14.interior: Everything solid metal; drinks in glasses or nutrient bags for access ports.

santo_domingo_15.name: NCPD Precinct #2
santo_domingo_15.interior: Three storeys, thick walls, electrified fence, turrets; stairs plus one cargo lift; squad rooms, cells and armouries mixed on floors 1-2; floor 3 is drone ops with repair bays, a Zhirafa tech and netrunners flying about a dozen Savannah Eagles.

santo_domingo_16.name: Northern Light Supplies

hooks.text: Its vendits probably sell black-market goods to anyone with the right codes: a cartel distribution network.

santo_domingo_16.interior: Plain logistics building with a three-truck fleet.

santo_domingo_17.name: Salón de Valentino

hooks.text: Rumour puts an El Norte operation in the basement bomb shelter; cartel boss Rubén Meza visits often.
Valentino's cartel-assigned bodyguard siblings may have switched their loyalty to her.
Nomads suspect losing candidate Genesis Durcal has been won over by Valentino.

santo_domingo_17.interior: Floor 1 public offices; floor 2 the City Manager's apartment and staff offices; rumoured cartel bunker in the basement.

santo_domingo_19.name: Woodchipper's Garage

hooks.text: Woodchipper and Theresa Valentino reportedly have bad blood from an old run-in.

santo_domingo_19.interior: Wide squat building with vehicle bays, lifts, benches and crates, none used for cars; her Night Market runs in a nearby cul-de-sac.

south_night_city_the_dirge.name: 101.9 The Dirge

hooks.text: The station drinks power and the Zoners are always scrounging new energy sources to stay on air.

south_night_city_the_dirge.interior: A mobile broadcast van rebuilt from scavenged cyberware, vehicle and weapon parts, disguised as rubble.

south_night_city_1.name: The Boneyard

hooks.text: The Sinful Adams come down hard on anyone desecrating the graves or homes.
Residents say they hear voices near the surviving headstones.

south_night_city_1.interior: Shacks among headstones; Poe's Respite, a three-room schoolhouse run by Gomez; The Crypt, a bar open most nights.

south_night_city_2.name: Combat Cabb Headquarters
south_night_city_2.interior: Four armoured bunkers round a courtyard: 1-2 vehicle fleet and repair bays, 3 dispatch and admin, 4 armory, quarters and rec; a double-reinforced wall with turret mounts.

south_night_city_3.name: Container Mart

hooks.text: Rumour says Melinda Joy and Haakensen go way back.
SlushSlurp will dust its shaved ice with synthcoke, blue glass or boost for a fee.

south_night_city_3.interior: Container shops: Ancestral Threads (hair salon), Chopper's (ripper dentist), Container Bodega, Getaway Tours (BD parlour), Old Lady Stuff (crafts, armour repair), Panik (nail salon), SlushSlurp.

south_night_city_duck_duck_dead.name: Duck. Duck. Dead!

hooks.text: Anyone who runs from a trio of tied clown dolls is dragged off by dozens of Bozos into the maze.
Recordings of each night's victims hit the market as XBDs weeks later.

south_night_city_duck_duck_dead.interior: A trap maze in an abandoned building: victims wake naked in shock collars that fire if they stand still 60 s; blade pits, acid showers, live panels, flamethrower drones, robot dogs, explosive toys; ends in a forced moral choice.

south_night_city_4.name: Fort Sumter
south_night_city_4.interior: 1F auditorium, chow hall, petition offices; 2F (friends only) rec room, ops centre, entertainment; basement and sub-basement (members only) bunks, gym, gun range, armory, security office; roof sniper nests and a pad for Gunslinger's prototype aerodyne cyberbike; bike garage behind.

south_night_city_fortitude_south.name: Fortitude South

hooks.text: Suspected US spy post recovering lost tech and watching key people and places in the city.
Culper Ring and Danger Gal operatives reportedly drop by to pass along information.

south_night_city_fortitude_south.interior: A state-of-the-art intelligence facility behind an abandoned facade, staffed by at least six officers.

south_night_city_5.name: GunMart

hooks.text: Rumour has the Enhanced meeting in the back warehouse.
The cheap guns could be a scheme to stir up violence and win converts to the Enhanced's cult of cyberpsychosis.

south_night_city_5.interior: Front aisles of guns and ammo by category, FBC guards and chromed cashiers; cavernous back warehouse of crated weapons awaiting shipment (made at the Heywood Industrial Zone factory).

south_night_city_6.name: Haakensen Tower

hooks.text: Haakensen may be tanking property values so fly-by-night firms can buy up the district for an unknown developer.
Nobody can explain why tiny Scythe Security won the district contract.
Haakensen's aide Greg Calters has a weakness for tall blondes.

south_night_city_6.interior: Haakensen's apartments and offices on the top floors; cronies rent the others; Scythe Security on 2F and the underground garage; a cafe, Mayoral Race, on the ground floor.

south_night_city_7.name: KidZ
south_night_city_7.interior: Patched-up junior high with automated defences; classrooms above, nursery and preschool in the basement; 20 volunteer staff.

south_night_city_8.name: Lazarus Training Center

hooks.text: Solos believe it stockpiles enough troops and munitions to invade a small country.

south_night_city_8.interior: Very thick walls, turrets, mines and trained guards; armoured vehicles, trucks, AVs and helicopters in constant traffic; every worker, down to the cooks, is Lazarus staff.

south_night_city_9.name: MAX-TAC HQ
south_night_city_9.interior: A fortified castle round a hidden rose garden: east tower vehicles (vans to AVs) and repair bays, west tower a top armory; between them meeting rooms, intel posts, comms, clinics, workshops, training, offices, barracks.

south_night_city_10.name: MindNutz Lover
south_night_city_10.interior: One storey: booths, dance floor and bar in one bright space, plus BD.

south_night_city_nostradamus_warehouse.name: Nostradamus' Warehouse

hooks.text: Nostradamus buys books and loaded memory chips from edgerunners.
He trades with a secretive tech-nomad clan and hints he is preparing for the day a wall falls.

south_night_city_nostradamus_warehouse.interior: A heavily defended warehouse of books and a massive NET architecture.

south_night_city_11.name: Savage Docs

hooks.text: Johnny B Good pays well for deliveries of new medical equipment.

south_night_city_11.interior: An old emergency centre with seven wings of three beds each and slightly dated gear; open 24/7; guarded by Tyger Claws and Kanzaki Family alike.

south_night_city_12.name: Silverhand Studios
south_night_city_12.owner_name: Kerry Eurodyne; run by Jomari Jackson (Exec 2/Fixer 2)
south_night_city_12.interior: Vaulted ceilings, skylights, configurable studio flats; murals repainted every few days.

south_night_city_13.name: The Slammer

hooks.text: Gangs from across the city book the Arena to settle disputes with agreed terms, and JessiGames runs the betting.

south_night_city_13.interior: East building: the cinder-block Arena; west building: dance floor and bar crammed with small tables; too loud to eavesdrop; no food.

south_night_city_14.name: South Cargo Village
south_night_city_14.interior: A cargo container community overlooked by NCPD snipers guarding The Glen.

south_night_city_15.name: South Night City Volunteer Fire Station
south_night_city_15.interior: A few mostly working fire engines, turnout gear and supplies; volunteer crew.

south_night_city_16.name: Union Chapel Building

hooks.text: The Reckoners preach the coming Harvest of Souls and lure listeners with cookies.

south_night_city_16.interior: Arched foyer and broken stained glass, battle-damaged.

the_glen_1.name: 1st Night City Bank

hooks.text: Night Corp's money for the city's contractors and companies passes through this bank.

the_glen_1.interior: The ground floor is public: marble, bulletproof windows, human tellers and side offices for loans. The vault is on the second floor, and getting between floors takes an ID card and a retina scan. On-site security and NCPD watch the cameras 24/7.

hooks.text: Urban legends say Sickle's Tear's tracks carry subliminal messages; DJ Nova says they don't.

the_glen_3.name: Air
the_glen_3.interior: Glass bars, rows of oxygen masks and steel stools.

the_glen_4.name: Archer & Li

hooks.text: Patricia Hawthorn, a junior architect buried in student debt, will sell blueprints for bribes.
The partners' architecture degrees were quietly backdated to cover how they won the Thurgood Towers contract.

the_glen_4.interior: An office next to Thurgood Towers.

the_glen_5.name: Bear's
the_glen_5.interior: A brewpub with an old bear's head over the bar and a short SCOP menu.

the_glen_6.name: Beth El Congregation
the_glen_6.interior: Three storeys, seating for more than 1,000, and 20 full-time staff.

the_glen_7.name: City Hall
the_glen_7.owner_name: Night City government (City Manager Zohara Freeman, Exec 7/Solo 2)

hooks.text: There is so much foot traffic that it's easy to slip into City Hall unnoticed if you're smart about it.

the_glen_7.interior: A wooden government building guarded by turrets, scanners, drones and NCPD's best, with maintenance crews working round the clock.

the_glen_8.name: Club Atlantis

hooks.text: Fixers work the corporate crowd here to make connections or gather blackmail.
Kernaghan's invite-only Midnight Market on the top two floors sells luxury goods to guests who can spend 10k eb.

the_glen_8.interior: Several levels with sliding staircases, moving mirror walls, robot dancers and a floating stage over the dance floor. The Midnight Market is on the top two floors, and Piranha dealers work the parking lot. The signature drink, the HALO Drop, costs 100eb.

the_glen_9.name: Consulate Causeway

hooks.text: Arasaka agents are rumoured to work out of the Japanese consulate.
It is an open secret that the US consulate hides intelligence operatives spying on NorCal with reunification in mind.
Persons unknown broke into the Southern California official's office at the US consulate and spray-painted TRAITOR on the walls.

the_glen_9.interior: A walled compound with a gatehouse where visitors wait for escorts. Missions: 9a EEC consulate (code 10, EEC troops, hardened light, 8 resident officials); 9b Japanese consulate (code 10, Japanese Self-Defence Force, hardened heavy, 20+ officials); 9c Mexican consulate (code 10, Mexican Army with chromed plain-clothes operatives, heavy); 9d Pacifica Confederation offices (code 10, NorCal Marshals, hardened heavy); 9e Organization of American States mission (code 10, OAS troops, heavy); 9f US consulate (code 10, Militech, hardened heavy, 4 resident officials plus the SoCal representative).

the_glen_10.name: Diplomatic Immunity
the_glen_10.owner_name: a Fixer posing as a low-level City Hall official (rumoured)

hooks.text: The basement sex club, posing as a secret society, caters to politicians from a dozen countries, and the Weng Fang Tong supplies the workers.
The club is rumoured to belong to a Fixer who poses as a minor City Hall official.

the_glen_10.interior: A two-storey box with three entrances, each guarded inside by chromed bodyguards in suits. The sex club is in the basement.

the_glen_11.name: DMV
the_glen_11.interior: In the sub-basement of the AV Traffic Control Tower.

the_glen_12.name: EuroBank

hooks.text: The mint's printing is run by the AI John Good inside guarded NET Architectures, with Netwatch on site.

the_glen_12.interior: A two-storey, block-long faux-Tudor building behind an electric fence, with steel-reinforced walls and screens instead of windows. It has an unknown number of secret sublevels (probably 3-4). Inside: layered biometrics, full-body scanners, many armed guards and several NET Architectures staffed 24/7. Divisions: retail, investment, loans and the mint.

the_glen_13.name: First Baptist Church of Night City

hooks.text: Reverend Turk is rumoured to sympathise with the Zoners and to hide their members when needed.

the_glen_14.name: Glenlife Perfected
the_glen_14.interior: A showy lobby and manager's office. Above them: a barely working elevator, flickering power and many tiny studios per floor.

the_glen_15.name: Hall of Justice

hooks.text: The judicial AI, The Judge, is rumoured to sit in a NET Architecture on the top floor, and a Netwatch AV is always parked on the roof.
In eight years no one has escaped from the underground cells without an expensive lawyer.
Donald Daniel Draper, a clerk in the DA's office, leaks and loses data for the Weng Fang Tong to pay off his gambling debts.

the_glen_15.interior: Towers, black steel doors and a portcullis. The stone halls echo, and drones, scanners and automated defences cover every room; NCPD stop-and-frisks staff at random. Civil matters on the lower floors, the DA and senior clerks in the middle, criminal trials on the upper floors. Prisoners are packed underground in tiny cells rigged with chemsprayers. The execution amphitheatre outside charges 20eb for a seat, 100eb for premium.

the_glen_16.name: Kasim's
the_glen_16.interior: Comfortable chairs and water pipes. Coffee is 10eb a cup, tobacco 20eb a packet.

the_glen_17.name: Lazarus Regional HQ
the_glen_17.interior: A plain-looking building with reinforced walls, guarded by staff and technology inside.

the_glen_19.name: Merrill, Asukaga & Finch Offices

hooks.text: Every employee has a brain implant that opens doors and elevators, and it is rumoured to explode if the firm decides they have betrayed it.

the_glen_19.interior: Twin towers with walkways every 10 floors. MA&F has the top floors, reached by appointment only with armed escorts, plus the usual guards, defences and cameras. About half the other floors are empty. Ground-floor tenants: 2A, a shooting range and gun shop (east tower); Ebony Chair barbers and the Body Lotto Office (west tower).

the_glen_20.name: The Molly May

hooks.text: Blackjack dealer Kelly Marion isn't a DeadWood and has a synthcoke habit that could get someone into the casino.
Missy Kitty will talk about her clients in exchange for real chocolate.

the_glen_20.interior: Floor 1: card casino with player pianos, two bars and a 24/7 kitchen. Floor 2: Western-style rooms at 20eb an hour or 100eb a day. The basement (supplies) and top floor (armoury, security centre, bunk room) need a rotating access code.

the_glen_21.name: NCPD Precinct #1

hooks.text: Only this precinct holds the central server of NCPD's private CitiNet and a vault of classified paper files.
NCPD auctions seized goods in the ground-floor auditorium on the third Friday of every month.
Deputy Chief Lark of Special Operations hires edgerunners for off-the-books jobs.

the_glen_21.interior: Ground floor: decontamination chamber, cyberware and weapon scanner, waiting area, fine-payment machine and an armed front desk. Above and below, the corridors form a maze with stun and lethal defences. Comms centre, holding cells, armoury, morgue, crime lab, drone rookery, central server and records vault. Neighbouring towers hold the AVs, copters and TAC armoured vehicles.

hooks.text: Tallson is said to have got rich by burying stories at the Bay Journal, which he later bought and merged into NCNT.
Tallson's sensational scoops are angering powerful people with guns.

the_glen_23.name: Night City Plaza
the_glen_23.interior: A lush park with a central concert stage. The statue and memorial on the south side are guarded.

the_glen_24.name: Raven Microcybernetics

hooks.text: Ziv Ellis is rumoured to have taken over Clean Sweep by assassinating its owner during the war; staff who sell client information die.

the_glen_24.interior: The lobby has opaque windows and a bulletproof door. Floors 1-39 hold Raven-affiliated tenants: Clean Sweep Enterprises (cleaning and bug sweeps), Dayton Aeronautics, Everest VentureWare, KillStrom Music (an EBM subsidiary) and Dr. William Galen's surgery. Raven itself is on floors 40-50.

hooks.text: The Voodoo Boys and Reckoners deal at the rave in a quiet alliance, and the Reckoners rob passed-out guests and leave a thank-you note.

the_glen_26.name: Souls Respite
the_glen_26.interior: A brick building on the edge of The Glen.

the_glen_27.name: World Stock Exchange

hooks.text: NCPD needs at least five minutes to get permission to enter, and the Lazarus guards only chase people who cause chaos, so fugitives who look the part can hide here.

the_glen_27.interior: Four storeys of trading floors and brokerage offices, open 24/7.

the_glen_28.name: Worthy Housing
the_glen_28.interior: Stacked high-cube containers with oversized doors, reinforced floors and metal furniture, next to a bulk brain-solution DRGS 247.

university_district_1.name: 94.4 NCU Radio
university_district_1.interior: A run-down brick building with a stage and a bar whose drink machine never gets the order right.

university_district_2.name: Biograph Theater
university_district_2.interior: Two screens, with film projectors kept running by volunteer engineering students.

university_district_3.name: Biotechnica Campus

hooks.text: Strange metal-on-metal sounds, howls and screams come from the locked domes at night, which doesn't fit Biotechnica's claim that the work there is botanical.
Hugh Hunter, a cyberpet cloning technician, smuggles rejected pets off campus to new homes.

university_district_3.interior: Office blocks, geodesic domes and rooftop terraces. Attraction Sphere Sigma is public (zoo, natural-history museum, Cyberpets); the other domes are locked. Armed guards patrol constantly with Custom Security Canines. A small green space survives from old Lake Park.

university_district_4.name: Biotechnica Habitation Sphere Alpha

hooks.text: Workers won't say why decontamination is so harsh; the narrator suspects drug or chemical-weapon development.

university_district_4.interior: A residential dome tied into the campus by tunnels with decontamination stations.

university_district_6.name: Carriage Street Books/Afterwords Café
university_district_6.interior: Bookshop on the ground floor; study café upstairs.

hooks.text: The Piranhas have tried several times to recruit Sam, who would rather own a shop than join a gang.

university_district_8.name: Food Truck Plaza
university_district_8.interior: Trucks include Buck-a-Slice, Captain Cajun's, Green Pretzels (made with Shroomer lichen), Happy Noodles, Kibble Cookie Kraze, Ramen Late, SoSushiMe and a vendit wagon. The NCU Yum app (5eb) tracks where they are.

university_district_10.name: Night City Symphony Hall

hooks.text: The Master's goth faction is at odds with Acme's prankster wing over where the gang is headed.

university_district_10.interior: Marble staircase, columns, huge doors and a red-velvet lobby. The gang uses it as HQ and stage; this semester's show is a mixed-style Dracula.

university_district_11.name: Night City University
university_district_11.owner_name: Night City University (Dean Edward Michaels, Exec 4/Fixer 6/Tech 4)

hooks.text: Continental Brands is lobbying the trustees to replace the campus bodega with an Oasis, and Petrochem wants a Hundred Under Haven there instead.
Knute Hall houses NCU's private CitiNet, run by a department head who helped build the Old Net.
A professor exposed as a serial killer of students was stopped by edgerunners, not Campus Security, and students backed by the Princesses are thinking of protesting.

university_district_11.interior: A walled campus of 13 buildings (11a-m). Administration (dean's office; Faculty Club in the basement). Blaine Building (social sciences; the Max-Pad security HQ in the basement). Brooks Library (underground study cells). The Cells (dorms with a shared lounge every other floor). Howard Wong Building (business). Michaels Hall (humanities). Knute Hall (computer science, private CitiNet). Loggagia Science Labs (scaffolded until 2047). Lombardy Groceries (bodega). NCU Clinic (ripperdoc). Schumacher Hall (arts). Science Tower (tallest; labs below, offices in the top third). Thompson Hall (gym, track, courts, firing range).

university_district_12.name: Parkside Living
university_district_12.interior: Studio flats above a main-floor lounge.

university_district_13.name: Princessland

hooks.text: Abusers who follow their victims to the shelter run into the Princesses' very real weapons.
Adorable personally killed her roommate's murderer, the son of a prominent Biotechnica exec.

university_district_13.interior: An old carnival ground. Open spaces are now gardens, the rides are fortifications and the stalls are housing. The gates turn away anyone who isn't bringing gifts or help.

university_district_15.name: Stems & Seeds

hooks.text: Because of an alliance with the Dirty Hippies, customers can collect ganja shipments here alongside their coded veg orders.

university_district_15.interior: Four floors of grow lights behind metal window shutters, with a turret on each corner and a day market outside.

hooks.text: Voodoo Boys sell drugs here, and Princesses of Justice on patrol keep clashing with them.

university_district_17.name: University Crèche
university_district_17.interior: Two guards on site during opening hours.

university_district_19.name: Yewtree

hooks.text: Yewtree has a quiet deal with Campus Security, and its bartenders pass campus gossip on to the cops.

university_district_19.interior: A well-lit neon bar with bouncers.

upper_marina_1.name: The Afterlife

hooks.text: Screens list available combat jobs; grudges must be taken outside.

upper_marina_1.interior: Salvaged autopsy tables and corpse coolers; three nested rooms: the Antechamber for rookies at the front, the Crypt main room, and Hades at the back where Rogue sits with the elite.

upper_marina_2.name: Bay Bridge Residences
upper_marina_2.owner_name: Tenants' Committee led by Marnie Maxwell (Exec 2)
upper_marina_2.interior: Lobby Combat Concierge bodega sells guns and ammo, repairs armour and hires out armed escorts; the always-open Night Owl bar on the top floor has soundproofed booths popular with Medias.

hooks.text: Rumour: Continental Brands secretly funds the cafe, which is how it gets new Kibble flavours before market.

upper_marina_4.name: Bright Forest Casino

hooks.text: Robinson allegedly ploughs the profits into low-interest loans for working-class small businesses and nonprofits.

upper_marina_4.interior: Faux woodwork and vintage roulette wheels in the former "Anything to Declare" hall.

upper_marina_5.name: Brownstone Waterfront

hooks.text: Scammers and criminals squat in empty units for days before security notices.

upper_marina_5.interior: Tenants: Chrysalis Therapy (drug/talk/braindance therapy), Corporate Cool (uniforms for NCPD, Many Hands, City Medical), Henson and Cox (defence law), High T Medicine (sports clinic), No/Brainer Software (GunMart-owned), Wolf's Crime Scene and Hazard Cleanup, WaveMo Water Taxi offices (Danny D Palma, a Prime-Time Player).

upper_marina_7.name: City Medical Center

hooks.text: Locals resent it for turning away poor patients and swallowing nearby homes as it keeps expanding.

upper_marina_7.interior: Huge hospital complex behind bulletproof windows overlooking the Flowertown tent city.

upper_marina_8.name: CMax

hooks.text: Visitors to the lobby food booths risk a shakedown by costumed gangers.

upper_marina_8.interior: Cinema with themed food booths in the lobby; "fashion night" parties in the abandoned warehouse next door.

upper_marina_9.name: Court Towers
upper_marina_9.interior: Monitors disguised as windows show the Marina; plush carpets, marble stairs, and a glass elevator over a massive atrium.

upper_marina_10.name: Crystal Park Market
upper_marina_10.interior: Stalls: Bill's salon, Cybershack (programs and deck hardware; Will Maine), Maxwell's cobbler, Other Lives (movies, braindance, blue glass), Pizza to Go, Skinlight fashionware, Tech Time tools and scrap, Torch's Total Repairs drop-off (Benicio).

upper_marina_11.name: Digital Divinity Incorporated, NC

hooks.text: Constant boardroom churn hints at schisms, especially since Netwatch raided DDI offices worldwide in 2037.

upper_marina_11.interior: Gleaming high-security tower with AV pads for high-profile adherents; the "All-Spring of Deus" NET Architecture.

upper_marina_12.name: Flowertown
upper_marina_12.owner_name: scavver groups and the Street Queens

hooks.text: The squatters have so far beaten off district cleanup programs and NCPD raids meant to close the camp.

upper_marina_12.interior: Shanties and tents where greenhouses stood.

upper_marina_13.name: The Forge

hooks.text: Maelstrom's "employees" are watched by guards in case they try to "leave work early".

upper_marina_13.interior: Open retail floor run as a repair line with clear guard sight lines; armoured shutters and walls scarred by bullets and rockets.

upper_marina_14.name: The Garden of Earthly Delights

hooks.text: Rumour: guests can indulge sadistic or even murderous impulses here.

upper_marina_14.interior: Menus, then a bathhouse, then private rooms; staff live in on-site dorms; food delivered by bike courier from local restaurants.

upper_marina_15.name: GraffitiX

hooks.text: Lola Lola's upcoming show here is rumoured to be worth over fifty million in total (p.67).

upper_marina_15.interior: Two floors of white space: free ground-floor hall, ticketed upper floor for special shows and artists in residence; exit through the gift shop.

upper_marina_16.name: The Grand Illusion
upper_marina_16.owner_name: Kerry Eurodyne (owner), managed by Filomena Reyes (Exec 5)
upper_marina_16.interior: Weapons checked at the door are always returned; ceiling mural of Samurai made from plastic wreckage; Thursday new-discoveries night.

upper_marina_17.name: Great River Storehouse

hooks.text: A warehouse overflowing with goods and Transporter drones tempts thieves, so Ziggurat hired Lazarus to guard it.

upper_marina_17.interior: Warehouse of commercial goods and Transporter delivery drones.

upper_marina_18.name: Hydrosubsidium R&D

hooks.text: A homeless Navy vet swears a dropped crate spilled gold and jewels, maybe treasure raised from the sea floor.
Nobody knows what the R&D department is working on.

upper_marina_18.interior: Twin warehouses with direct marina access, discreet signs, gate guards and a new chain-link fence closing the waterfront.

hooks.text: Corp security tries to evict the occupants whenever the property goes to auction, and the battles wreck it further.

upper_marina_21.name: La Lune Bleue
upper_marina_21.interior: Solid door staff, then Maurice in the lobby, who admits only people on his updated list of the prestigious.

upper_marina_22.name: Marina Breeze Apartments
upper_marina_22.interior: Attached docks hold water taxis and small sport-fishing boats.

upper_marina_23.name: Marina FloatHomes
upper_marina_23.interior: Motorhome-sized units moored between three-storey structures piled on disguised cargo barges; semi-legal water taxis.

upper_marina_25.name: McCartney Field Stadium

hooks.text: Rumour: the Nuke just poached a star murderball player from Vancouver (p.67).
The Heat are one strong star away from contention.

upper_marina_25.interior: Home of the Slammers (baseball), Heat (basketball), Death Dealers (combat soccer), Nuke (murderball) and the NBCL Tanks in the Tank cage fights over electrified water.

upper_marina_26.name: Megabuilding H8 Construction Site

hooks.text: Chung publicly calls it affordable housing but would love to see it burn.
Swinger, an AllNations equipment driver, takes bribes to lend out heavy machines for a quick job (p.78).
Morro Strand Yacht Club members file nuisance suits against anyone tied to the project.

upper_marina_26.interior: Active construction site guarded by Aldecaldos.

upper_marina_27.name: Metal Heaven

hooks.text: The Prime-Time Players feud with the store over its thin stock of theme songs and soundtracks and sometimes cause trouble.
Peace is kept by hired edgerunners and payoffs to Maelstrom.

upper_marina_27.interior: Renovated warehouse store with in-house instrument Techs.

upper_marina_28.name: Midnight Arms Regional Office

hooks.text: A crate of Mustang Arms-labelled Mark IIIs might still sit in the back of the warehouse.

upper_marina_28.interior: Manufacturing lines and warehouse behind a small public showroom.

upper_marina_30.name: The Neon Johnson
upper_marina_30.interior: Basement bar; regulars dislike strangers interrupting the music.

upper_marina_31.name: Night City Bubbles

hooks.text: Masseuse Pixie Stix will talk about her regulars in useful detail for a mint rare Goosetopia figure (p.78).

upper_marina_31.interior: Door security by off-duty NCPD; bodyguards wait in the Associates' Lounge.

upper_marina_32.name: Night City Convention Center
upper_marina_32.interior: Two large lower floors of halls and auditoriums; two glass towers above for staff, district offices, the City Manager and VIP lounges; skybridge Night Sky Room; public areas decent, towers locked down hard.

hooks.text: The occasional suspiciously well-equipped, guarded speedboat moors here.
Scavvers dodge security and stow away in trailers for choice salvage; most weeks someone dies in the machinery.

upper_marina_35.name: Quarantine
upper_marina_35.interior: Booths are repurposed kennels; back room with pool tables hosts Fixit Fridays; communal toolkit kept behind the bar.

upper_marina_36.name: REO Meatwagon
upper_marina_36.interior: Massive bunker by the brackish channel: garage of Ambunaughts, repair workshops, offices, dispatch, bunk rooms and an armory.

upper_marina_37.name: TravlStay CityCenter
upper_marina_37.interior: Paper-thin cubes in the hotel and the annexed high-rise.

upper_marina_38.name: Upper Marina Substation 2
upper_marina_38.interior: Substation inside a wrought-iron facade; Realgrass park with a dedicated NCPD presence.

upper_marina_39.name: Ziggurat Corporate Terrace
upper_marina_39.interior: Apartments under the HQ curve; saunas, infinity pools and gym for Rank Z3+; door screens show each resident's Patch; windows sealed after a viral suicide.

upper_marina_40.name: Ziggurat Headquarters

hooks.text: Where in the tower the city's CitiNet servers sit is a closely guarded secret, kept even from the NCFD.

upper_marina_40.interior: Lower floors: bays for CitiNet repair vehicles and tech squads; middle: development, CitiNet and Data Pool content control, sales; upper: executives, UR's suite at the apex of the curve; public first floor with the Ihara-Grubb Net Museum and a press auditorium; private fire/EMS station at the base.

hooks.text: Patriarch Kenji Akagi trained Arasaka troops before the 4CW, and nobody is sure where his loyalties lie now.
Takeru Akagi, head of the Kimen-Gumi, drops by to scout recruits.

watson_development_2.name: Canadian Consulate

hooks.text: Rumour says the consulate covers a Canadian operation to recover Old Net data.
Kane helps Petrochem in its efforts against SovOil.
Kane is having an affair with City Manager Lucius Rhyne.

watson_development_2.interior: Clean, heavily automated offices guarded by a detachment of Canadian soldiers; Kane and three clerks live on site.

watson_development_3.name: City Tot Daycare

hooks.text: The daycare is an Arzin Tynon front; smuggled goods move through its garage in diaper-service trucks several times a day.

watson_development_3.interior: Daycare with a garage that service trucks pull in and out of all day.

watson_development_4.name: Ebunike Docks

hooks.text: The docks let NCCS corps land Asian cargo from Darangen sea nomads without going through the Thelas-run Port; relations with the Thelas are cordial for now.
Tyger Claws sell drugs and gambling to the dock workers.

watson_development_4.interior: Laborers in linear frames unload crates onto trucks for the Fork; a ship is said to be permanently moored here.

watson_development_5.name: Faisal's Customs

hooks.text: Genius weaponsmith Faisal keeps moving, convinced a big arms maker will snatch him with an assault squad.
Buggy mass-produces cheap guns from Faisal's unfinished sketches.

watson_development_5.interior: A small factory where low-level Techs turn out vendit and bodega firearms around the clock.

watson_development_6.name: The Fork

hooks.text: Rumour puts Night City's Elflines Online servers in the basement of the Segotari console plant.
Gibson Battlegear wants to expand but Towa owns the best nearby land.
After dark gogangs, nomads and street racers own the roads; the Dragula Racers hold the monthly wins record.

watson_development_6.interior: Polluted industrial zone west of the base. Code drops to 4 (NCPD, Hardened Light) at night. Sites: 6a Bodyweight distribution centre, 6b Cactus Water bottling plant (closed), 6c Gibson Battlegear armour plant, 6d Hammered Industries chemical warehouse, 6e Kendachi distribution hub, 6f Kiroshi cyberoptics plant, 6g Makigai auto factory (awaiting parts), 6h Segotari console plant, 6i Towa weapons plant (just broke ground).

watson_development_10.name: HTown

hooks.text: Every few weeks NCPD or hired muscle tries to clear the camp, and the Arzin Tynon lead its residents in the fight back.
The Arzin Tynon run their smuggling operation from the camp.

watson_development_10.interior: A homeless camp rebuilt against the east wall of a half-empty gated Exec community put up by Future BuildWorks.

watson_development_12.name: Joint Temporary Housing Solution

hooks.text: Both corps' previous housing blocks were destroyed by unknown parties.
A Rhyne-brokered truce splits elevators and tennis courts between the rival staff; one bad day could turn it into a war zone.

watson_development_12.interior: Cheaply thrown-together block: left elevator Petrochem, right SovOil; east tennis court Petrochem, west SovOil; shared rooftop jacuzzi; the pool is still disputed.

watson_development_13.name: Megabuilding H10

hooks.text: G3 is rumoured to be sabotaging 98.2 Shiv FM's Saturday parties, which have turned violent.
G3 sell media chips, drugs and sex on the lower levels, to NCPD's annoyance.
Most of Watson Community College's Night Corp grant went into the owner's pocket.

watson_development_13.interior: Cubes on the lower floors, then container-size units, conapts and apartments, up to luxury suites with private bars and the members-only Highwall Club; courtyard basketball. Tenants: 98.2 Shiv FM (roof), Big H Casino (pachinko, monthly high-stakes poker), Data Inc, Hammer Me Nail Salon, United Martial Arts, Watson Community College.

watson_development_14.name: Megabuilding H11
watson_development_14.owner_name: Future BuildWorks (Kanzaki-backed; CEO Yasume Ishioda, Exec 4)

hooks.text: Rumour says H11's foundations are full of the bodies of people who crossed the Kanzaki Family.
The Kanzakis are said to plant subliminal messages through Delta 777's braindances.
The Wild Things recruit fighters at Iron Spirit.
Future BuildWorks CEO Yasume Ishioda still pines for PI Kenshiro Saeba and might leave her loveless Kanzaki marriage for him.

watson_development_14.interior: Only partly built; lower floors already house factory and dock workers. Tenants: 107.2 KCP2, Delta 777 braindance parlour, Divine Tastes, Future BuildWorks office, Iron Spirit boxing gym, Savage Docs North (two Medtechs).

watson_development_15.name: Morgan's
watson_development_15.interior: A weapons-and-armour food truck, usually parked on Jankel Street.

watson_development_16.name: NCPD Precinct #3

hooks.text: Excessive-force complaints are up 50% since the strike, and Captain Stone nearly came to blows with City Manager Rhyne.

watson_development_16.interior: Ground floor: small lobby, motor pool and high-speed pursuit unit; upper floors: offices, squad and briefing rooms, armories, evidence lock-up, interrogation; top two floors the NCPD Academy; roof AV and gyrocopter pads; basement morgue and holding cells. The Blue Ranger seized-goods store is across the street.

watson_development_17.name: NeoSoviet Consulate

hooks.text: At least one of the consul's seven clerks spies for the Consortium.

watson_development_17.interior: Brutalist building built to survive an invasion, guarded by SovOil security; no staff live on site.

watson_development_18.name: The Obituary
watson_development_18.interior: Converted warehouse with room for dozens of vehicles, horror-movie decor; the leader lives in the old manager's office above the main floor.

watson_development_20.name: Oumei-ji Temple
watson_development_20.interior: Houses an 18 m hollow Buddha (the Night City Daibutsu) said to hold scriptures, a list of 4CW dead and some of their ashes; Tyger Claws loyalists run street-food stalls out front.

watson_development_21.name: Petrochem Offices
watson_development_21.owner_name: Petrochem (Night City ops: William Joseph "Billy Joe" Brentwood, Exec 8)

hooks.text: NCPD detectives come about once a week to look into another murder.
Billy Joe Brentwood's vices make him a favourite blackmail target, though blackmailers tend to end up in the harbour.
Brentwood hates his SovOil counterpart across the street with a murderous passion.

watson_development_21.interior: Fortified; public access only to a small propaganda museum and gift shop, everything beyond biometrically locked and patrolled around the clock.

hooks.text: The strip between the Petrochem and SovOil refineries is a no man's land where guards from both sides shoot intruders.

watson_development_23.name: The Pochinko Carnival
watson_development_23.owner_name: Pochinko clan of Blood Nation nomads (Libby Manseau, Nomad 4/Rockerboy 5)

hooks.text: The carnival pays a 10eb bounty for every genuine Bozo nose.

watson_development_23.interior: Small boardwalk of well-kept rides and games; nightly show by classically trained clowns.

watson_development_24.name: Red Oktober
watson_development_24.interior: Built in a disused subway station, dressed as a Soviet submarine.

watson_development_25.name: Redline

hooks.text: Redline has long been rumoured to host death matches; nobody has proved it.

watson_development_25.interior: A bar built around a fighting pit.

hooks.text: SkidRow is said to be negotiating with Danger Gal on a Puma Squad-style armour line, and rival Gibson Battlegear is furious; a bloody fashion war may be coming.

watson_development_28.name: Smash/Cut
watson_development_28.interior: A few tables around a huge dance floor, wall vidscreens and floor/ceiling holoprojectors; staff use sign language over the noise.

watson_development_29.name: Snack & Shack

hooks.text: Tyger Claws 'artists' record XBDs in the rear containers; ignore the screams.

watson_development_29.interior: Cargo containers: the front two welded into a bodega, the middle rented as month-to-month housing, the rear used as an XBD studio.

watson_development_30.name: SovOil Offices

hooks.text: NCPD detectives come about once a week to look into another murder.
Tealov keeps up his feud with Petrochem's Brentwood, some say mostly for laughs.

watson_development_30.interior: Fortified; public access only to a small propaganda museum and gift shop, everything beyond biometrically locked and patrolled around the clock.

hooks.text: The strip between the SovOil and Petrochem refineries is a no man's land where guards from both sides shoot intruders.

watson_development_32.name: Trauma Team Tower
watson_development_32.interior: Client-only hospital, AV maintenance and launch bays for each squad, tactical air control tower; dispatch and executive offices buried in the subbasement. Lazarus guards it and all TT staff carry arms on duty.

watson_development_33.name: Trauma Team Corporate Living Center

hooks.text: Every surface is covered in biosensors, and residents suspect the data goes to management despite promises of confidentiality.

watson_development_33.interior: 'The Ward': linked to the Tower by an access tunnel; gym and rec centre with smoothie bar, urgent care clinic, in-house therapists.

watson_development_34.name: Turbo Neon Motors
watson_development_34.interior: Two storeys, six service bays, on-site custom parts fabrication.

watson_development_38.name: Whammer Arena
watson_development_38.owner_name: Watson Whammers / Wonderland Roller Derby League
watson_development_38.interior: 3,000 seats with modern broadcast gear; also rented for concerts.
